story.x: The real workflows we demonstrate are starting points to help you discover what Violoop can do in your own daily work. Its capabilities extend far beyond these examples; we encourage you to experiment, try new ideas, and find ways to make Violoop work for you.

story.x: We look forward to seeing the workflows you create and learning from your experiences as we continue to improve Violoop together with our community.

story.x: Your personal on-device AI—with long-context memory that learns how you work. Violoop brings screen understanding and personal memory on-device, learning your habits, projects, and preferences entirely locally, with no cloud computing costs.
story.z: 您的个人设备上人工智能——具有长上下文记忆，可以了解您的工作方式。 Violoop 在设备上提供屏幕理解和个人记忆，完全在本地了解您的习惯、项目和偏好，无需云计算成本。

story.x: By combining OCR with a local model that understands long-form context, Violoop proactively moves your work forward—so you don’t have to write lengthy prompts for every task.
story.z: 通过将 OCR 与理解长格式上下文的本地模型相结合，Violoop 可以主动推动您的工作，因此您不必为每项任务编写冗长的提示。

story.x: Violoop reads and understands the text, pages, and interactive elements on your screen in real time. It controls your computer through mouse and keyboard inputs, carrying out tasks across apps without relying on app-specific APIs.
story.z: Violoop 实时读取并理解屏幕上的文本、页面和交互元素。它通过鼠标和键盘输入控制您的计算机，跨应用程序执行任务，而无需依赖应用程序特定的 API。

story.x: Violoop separates AI processing from independent security control through its dual-chip architecture. The processing chip runs the local model, while the security chip enforces physical authorization for sensitive actions.
story.z: Violoop 通过其双芯片架构将人工智能处理与独立的安全控制分开。处理芯片运行本地模型，而安全芯片则对敏感操作强制执行物理授权。

story.x: Violoop connects your computer and phone so work can continue beyond your desk. As long as your computer remains on and connected, Violoop can run tasks around the clock. From your phone, you can remotely view your computer’s screen, check task progress, and give new instructions.
story.z: Violoop 连接您的计算机和手机，以便您可以在办公桌外继续工作。只要您的计算机保持开启并连接，Violoop 就可以全天候运行任务。通过手机，您可以远程查看计算机屏幕、检查任务进度并给出新指令。

story.x: Violoop can view and interact with two screens simultaneously, so you and Violoop can work on the same computer without getting in each other’s way.
story.z: Violoop 可以同时查看两个屏幕并与之交互，因此您和 Violoop 可以在同一台计算机上工作，而不会互相妨碍。

story.x: Violoop is for people who repeatedly extract information, copy and paste, fill out forms, organize files, and follow up on tasks. These activities have clear goals and repeatable steps, but are spread across different apps—taking time and interrupting focus.
story.z: Violoop 适合那些反复提取信息、复制和粘贴、填写表格、组织文件和跟踪任务的人员。这些活动有明确的目标和可重复的步骤，但分布在不同的应用程序中，既耗时又分散注意力。

story.x: Violoop handles the repetitive work across your apps, so you can focus on decisions, conversations, and creativity.
story.z: Violoop 可以处理您应用程序中的重复性工作，因此您可以专注于决策、对话和创造力。

story.x: Unlike many lights designed for a single purpose, the WUBEN G6’s compact design opens up more ways to use it. Lightweight and easy to carry, it fits naturally into everyday life and on the go. Wherever life takes you, you can find a place for the G6.
story.z: 与许多专为单一用途设计的灯不同，WUBEN G6 的紧凑设计开辟了更多使用方式。它重量轻且易于携带，自然适合日常生活和旅途。无论生活带您去往何处，G6 都能为您找到一席之地。

story.x: The slim, portable WUBEN G6 offers adjustable brightness from 1 to 500 lumens and a beam distance of up to 66 m. From evening walks and home repairs to outdoor adventures and unexpected power outages, it’s ready to light up everyday moments.
story.z: 纤薄便携的 WUBEN G6 提供 1 至 500 流明的可调亮度，光束距离可达 66 m。从晚间散步和房屋维修到户外探险和意外停电，它随时可以照亮日常生活。

story.x: Beyond its main beam, the WUBEN G6 offers practical light right at the front. Two 1 W white LEDs deliver 100 lumens for close-up tasks, from checking your gear to making a quick repair. A compact red/blue indicator adds even more versatility: its 2-lumen red light can be used as a signal, and the indicator also shows the light’s power status.
story.z: 除了主光束之外，WUBEN G6 还在前方提供实用的光线。两个 1 W 白色 LED 可为近距离任务（从检查装备到快速维修）提供 100 流明的亮度。紧凑的红/蓝指示灯增加了更多的多功能性：其 2 流明红灯可用作信号，并且指示灯还显示灯的电源状态。

story.x: Slim, easy-to-carry design has been at the heart of the WUBEN G6 from the start. Thinner, then thinner still: at its narrowest point, the G6 is nearly as thin as a USB connector. The result is a thoughtful balance of everyday functionality and effortless portability.
story.z: 纤薄、易于携带的设计从一开始就是 WUBEN G6 的核心。越来越薄：在最窄处，G6 几乎与 USB 连接器一样薄。结果是日常功能和轻松便携性之间的深思熟虑的平衡。

story.x: The WUBEN G6’s concealed, three-way rotating clip quickly became a standout feature for its versatility. For the G6, we’ve taken that idea further with a thicker, sturdier clip and a wider opening, making it easier to attach to your gear and designed for a more secure hold. Clip it on, adjust the angle, and keep your light right where you need it.
story.z: WUBEN G6 的隐藏式三向旋转夹因其多功能性而迅速成为一个突出的特点。对于 G6，我们进一步采用了这一理念，采用了更厚、更坚固的夹子和更宽的开口，使其更容易连接到您的装备，并设计得更牢固。将其夹上，调整角度，然后将灯光保持在您需要的位置。

story.x: On the side opposite the G6’s rotating clip, a compact folding blade is integrated for everyday tasks and outdoor needs. It’s handy for opening packages, cutting cord, or taking care of quick campsite tasks.
story.z: 在 G6 旋转夹的对面，集成了一个紧凑的折叠刀片，可满足日常任务和户外需求。它可以方便地打开包裹、剪断电源线或处理快速的露营地任务。

story.x: The mini knife detaches from the G6, so you can choose how you carry it. Keep it attached for an all-in-one setup, or remove and stow it separately when you want to carry the G6 on its own. We’re also exploring additional accessory-mounting options to give you more ways to customize your setup.
story.z: 迷你刀与 G6 分离，因此您可以选择携带方式。将其固定以实现一体化设置，或者当您想单独携带 G6 时将其取下并单独存放。我们还在探索其他配件安装选项，为您提供更多自定义设置的方法。

story.x: We took a different approach with the G6’s switch. It responds to a light press with clear, direct tactile feedback, making operation simple and intuitive. Water won’t interrupt its response. Even underwater, the switch remains usable. A breakthrough in switch design that makes everyday operation easier.
story.z: 我们对 G6 的开关采取了不同的方法。轻轻一按，它就会产生清晰、直接的触觉反馈，使操作变得简单直观。水不会中断其反应。即使在水下，开关仍然可用。开关设计的突破，让日常操作更加轻松。

story.x: The G6’s high-density 400 mAh battery is protected against overcharging, over-discharge, overcurrent, and short circuits. Electrical insulation adds another layer of protection. The G6 also supports use while charging, so you can keep using the light while it’s plugged in.
story.z: G6 的高密度 400 mAh 电池具有防过度充电、过度放电、过流和短路保护。电气绝缘增加了另一层保护。 G6 还支持边充电边使用，因此您可以在插入电源时继续使用灯。

story.x: Made for everyday carry and long-term use, the WUBEN G6 clips onto clothing, backpacks, or key rings with a light press and detaches just as easily. Tested through more than 100,000 press cycles, the sturdy spring clip can support a 5 kg load, providing a secure, dependable hold day after day.
story.z: WUBEN G6 专为日常携带和长期使用而设计，只需轻轻一按即可夹在衣服、背包或钥匙圈上，也可以轻松拆卸。经过超过 100,000 次按压循环测试，坚固的弹簧夹可支撑 5 公斤负载，日复一日地提供安全、可靠的固定。

story.x: The Standard and Premium versions are identical in every way except for their materials. The Standard version is CNC-machined from 7075 aerospace-grade aluminum, while the Premium version is made from stonewashed titanium alloy.
story.z: 标准版和高级版除了材质不同外，在各方面都相同。标准版由 7075 航空级铝材 CNC 加工而成，而高级版则由石磨钛合金制成。

story.x: From leash pulling and recall to off-leash boundaries and barking, DogVibe gives you one consistent way to communicate with your dog, so everyday training leads to something bigger: more trust, more confidence, and more freedom together.

story.x: MindBridge is a desktop AI assistant that runs on your computer.
story.z: MindBridge 是一个在您的计算机上运行的桌面人工智能助手。

story.x: It chats, reads the files you attach, searches a knowledge base you own, works with documents and folders, analyzes photos on-device, generates images if you want, takes voice input, pops up over any app with a shortcut, and can set local reminders.
story.z: 它可以聊天、读取您附加的文件、搜索您拥有的知识库、处理文档和文件夹、分析设备上的照片、根据需要生成图像、接受语音输入、通过快捷方式在任何应用程序上弹出，并且可以设置本地提醒。

story.x: No mandatory cloud.
story.z: 没有强制云。

story.x: No telemetry.
story.z: 没有遥测。

story.x: No forced subscription.
story.z: 没有强制订阅。

story.x: If you want extra tools, a setup wizard explains them in plain language and gives you one-click links to the official download pages.
story.z: 如果您需要额外的工具，安装向导会以简单的语言进行解释，并为您提供官方下载页面的一键链接。

story.x: That usually means four things:
story.z: 这通常意味着四件事：

story.x: *   Your chats leave your device
story.z: * 您的聊天内容离开您的设备

story.x: *   Your workflow dies without internet
story.z: * 如果没有互联网，你的工作流程就会终止

story.x: *   Your privacy is a policy you did not write
story.z: * 您的隐私政策不是您制定的

story.x: *   The product can disappear behind a paywall, an outage, or a new terms page
story.z: * 产品可能会在付费专区、中断或新条款页面后消失

story.x: If you draft client documents, keep research notes, write fiction, or ship code, that trade is getting harder to defend.
story.z: 如果你起草客户文件、保留研究笔记、写小说或发布代码，那么这种交易就会变得越来越难以捍卫。

story.x: We built the opposite default.
story.z: 我们建立了相反的默认值。

story.x: Your computer is the trust boundary.
story.z: 您的计算机是信任边界。

story.x: Conversations stay on the machine. Files stay on the machine. You choose the model. You choose whether anything ever goes online.
story.z: 对话保留在机器上。文件保留在机器上。你选择型号。您可以选择是否有任何内容上线。

story.x: MindBridge is a native app for Windows and macOS.
story.z: MindBridge 是适用于 Windows 和 macOS 的本机应用程序。

story.x: Local models run through [![Image 2](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=ollama.com&sz=64)Ollama](https://ollama.com/)(free). End users do not need Python. The wizard helps you install Ollama, pick a model for the work you actually do — writing, coding, research, creative work, or everyday help — and download it with a progress bar.
story.z: 本地模型通过 [![图片 2](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=ollama.com&sz=64)Ollama](https://ollama.com/)（免费）运行。最终用户不需要Python。该向导可帮助您安装 Ollama，为您实际从事的工作（写作、编码、研究、创意工作或日常帮助）选择一个模型，然后通过进度条下载它。

story.x: On a 16 GB laptop, MindBridge recommends models that fit. If RAM or CPU load spikes, automatic routing can drop to a lighter installed model instead of freezing the machine.
story.z: 在 16 GB 笔记本电脑上，MindBridge 推荐适合的型号。如果 RAM 或 CPU 负载激增，自动路由可以下降到安装较轻的型号，而不是冻结机器。

story.x: Optional cloud features stay behind a door you open. In Settings → Privacy you can Force local-only mode: web search, cloud image backends, and cloud vision stay off even when you have internet.
story.z: 可选的云功能就在您打开的门后面。在“设置”→“隐私”中，您可以强制仅使用本地模式：即使有互联网，网络搜索、云图像后端和云视觉也会保持关闭状态。

story.x: You drop a PDF into chat.
story.z: 您将 PDF 放入聊天中。

story.x: “Summarize this.” “Rewrite it in a professional tone.” “Extract the dates.” The attachment can be one-time (that message only) or saved into your private knowledge base. It is not an upload to a random website.
story.z: “总结一下。” “用专业的语气重写它。” “提取日期。”该附件可以是一次性的（仅限该消息），也可以保存到您的私人知识库中。它不是上传到随机网站。

story.x: Unlike many lights designed for a single purpose, the WUBEN G6’s compact design opens up more ways to use it. Lightweight and easy to carry, it fits naturally into everyday life and on the go. Wherever life takes you, you can find a place for the G6.

story.x: The slim, portable WUBEN G6 offers adjustable brightness from 1 to 500 lumens and a beam distance of up to 66 m. From evening walks and home repairs to outdoor adventures and unexpected power outages, it’s ready to light up everyday moments.
story.z: 纤薄便携的 WUBEN G6 提供 1 至 500 流明的可调亮度，光束距离可达 66 m。从晚间散步和房屋维修到户外探险和意外停电，它随时可以照亮日常生活。

story.x: Beyond its main beam, the WUBEN G6 offers practical light right at the front. Two 1 W white LEDs deliver 100 lumens for close-up tasks, from checking your gear to making a quick repair. A compact red/blue indicator adds even more versatility: its 2-lumen red light can be used as a signal, and the indicator also shows the light’s power status.
story.z: 除了主光束之外，WUBEN G6 还在前方提供实用的光线。两个 1 W 白色 LED 可为近距离任务（从检查装备到快速维修）提供 100 流明的亮度。紧凑的红/蓝指示灯增加了更多的多功能性：其 2 流明红灯可用作信号，并且指示灯还显示灯的电源状态。

story.x: Slim, easy-to-carry design has been at the heart of the WUBEN G6 from the start. Thinner, then thinner still: at its narrowest point, the G6 is nearly as thin as a USB connector. The result is a thoughtful balance of everyday functionality and effortless portability.
story.z: 纤薄、易于携带的设计从一开始就是 WUBEN G6 的核心。越来越薄：在最窄处，G6 几乎与 USB 连接器一样薄。结果是日常功能和轻松便携性之间的深思熟虑的平衡。

story.x: The WUBEN G6’s concealed, three-way rotating clip quickly became a standout feature for its versatility. For the G6, we’ve taken that idea further with a thicker, sturdier clip and a wider opening, making it easier to attach to your gear and designed for a more secure hold. Clip it on, adjust the angle, and keep your light right where you need it.
story.z: WUBEN G6 的隐藏式三向旋转夹因其多功能性而迅速成为一个突出的特点。对于 G6，我们进一步采用了这一理念，采用了更厚、更坚固的夹子和更宽的开口，使其更容易连接到您的装备，并设计得更牢固。将其夹上，调整角度，然后将灯光保持在您需要的位置。

story.x: On the side opposite the G6’s rotating clip, a compact folding blade is integrated for everyday tasks and outdoor needs. It’s handy for opening packages, cutting cord, or taking care of quick campsite tasks.
story.z: 在 G6 旋转夹的对面，集成了一个紧凑的折叠刀片，可满足日常任务和户外需求。它可以方便地打开包裹、剪断电源线或处理快速的露营地任务。

story.x: The mini knife detaches from the G6, so you can choose how you carry it. Keep it attached for an all-in-one setup, or remove and stow it separately when you want to carry the G6 on its own. We’re also exploring additional accessory-mounting options to give you more ways to customize your setup.
story.z: 迷你刀与 G6 分离，因此您可以选择携带方式。将其固定以实现一体化设置，或者当您想单独携带 G6 时将其取下并单独存放。我们还在探索其他配件安装选项，为您提供更多自定义设置的方法。

story.x: We took a different approach with the G6’s switch. It responds to a light press with clear, direct tactile feedback, making operation simple and intuitive. Water won’t interrupt its response. Even underwater, the switch remains usable. A breakthrough in switch design that makes everyday operation easier.
story.z: 我们对 G6 的开关采取了不同的方法。轻轻一按，它就会产生清晰、直接的触觉反馈，使操作变得简单直观。水不会中断其反应。即使在水下，开关仍然可用。开关设计的突破，让日常操作更加轻松。

story.x: The G6’s high-density 400 mAh battery is protected against overcharging, over-discharge, overcurrent, and short circuits. Electrical insulation adds another layer of protection. The G6 also supports use while charging, so you can keep using the light while it’s plugged in.
story.z: G6 的高密度 400 mAh 电池具有防过度充电、过度放电、过流和短路保护。电气绝缘增加了另一层保护。 G6 还支持边充电边使用，因此您可以在插入电源时继续使用灯。

story.x: Made for everyday carry and long-term use, the WUBEN G6 clips onto clothing, backpacks, or key rings with a light press and detaches just as easily. Tested through more than 100,000 press cycles, the sturdy spring clip can support a 5 kg load, providing a secure, dependable hold day after day.
story.z: WUBEN G6 专为日常携带和长期使用而设计，只需轻轻一按即可夹在衣服、背包或钥匙圈上，也可以轻松拆卸。经过超过 100,000 次按压循环测试，坚固的弹簧夹可支撑 5 公斤负载，日复一日地提供安全、可靠的固定。

story.x: The Standard and Premium versions are identical in every way except for their materials. The Standard version is CNC-machined from 7075 aerospace-grade aluminum, while the Premium version is made from stonewashed titanium alloy.

story.x: Violoop reads and understands the text, pages, and interactive elements on your screen in real time. It controls your computer through mouse and keyboard inputs, carrying out tasks across apps without relying on app-specific APIs.
story.z: Violoop 实时读取并理解屏幕上的文本、页面和交互元素。它通过鼠标和键盘输入控制您的计算机，跨应用程序执行任务，而无需依赖应用程序特定的 API。

story.x: Violoop separates AI processing from independent security control through its dual-chip architecture. The processing chip runs the local model, while the security chip enforces physical authorization for sensitive actions.

story.x: Violoop connects your computer and phone so work can continue beyond your desk. As long as your computer remains on and connected, Violoop can run tasks around the clock. From your phone, you can remotely view your computer’s screen, check task progress, and give new instructions.
story.z: Violoop 连接您的计算机和手机，以便您可以在办公桌外继续工作。只要您的计算机保持开启并连接，Violoop 就可以全天候运行任务。通过手机，您可以远程查看计算机屏幕、检查任务进度并给出新指示。

story.x: Violoop can view and interact with two screens simultaneously, so you and Violoop can work on the same computer without getting in each other’s way.
story.z: Violoop 可以同时查看两个屏幕并与之交互，因此您和 Violoop 可以在同一台计算机上工作，而不会互相妨碍。

story.x: Violoop is for people who repeatedly extract information, copy and paste, fill out forms, organize files, and follow up on tasks. These activities have clear goals and repeatable steps, but are spread across different apps—taking time and interrupting focus.

story.x: Manual sourdough math is a stressful chore. Bake a Plan will automate your baking timeline so you never have to again.
story.z: 手工酵母数学是一项压力很大的苦差事。烘焙计划将使您的烘焙时间表自动化，这样您就不必再这样做了。

story.x: Sourdough baking is a beautiful craft but too often, the logistical planning of a bake feels like a stressful, mathematical chore. Between scheduling starter feeding intervals, anticipating peak ripeness, and manually working backward from your target oven time, it's easy to feel lost. Sourdough has a mind of its own, and managing it can feel like a full-time job.
story.z: 酸面团烘焙是一门美丽的手艺，但很多时候，烘焙的后勤规划感觉像是一项压力很大的数学苦差事。在安排发酵剂饲喂间隔、预测成熟度高峰以及从目标烤箱时间手动向后工作之间，很容易感到迷失。酸面团有自己的想法，管理它感觉就像是一份全职工作。

story.x: I want to build Bake a Plan to change that. With your support, I want to create a dynamic baking companion that automates your timeline and fits baking seamlessly into your active schedule. The primary purpose of this Kickstarter campaign is to fund the development of a functional prototype, paving the way for a stress-free baking experience where you can say goodbye to complicated math, tedious spreadsheets, and the anxiety that often comes with planning.
story.z: 我想制定一个烘焙计划来改变这一点。在您的支持下，我想创建一个动态烘焙伴侣，使您的时间线自动化，并将烘焙无缝地融入您的活动日程中。此次 Kickstarter 活动的主要目的是资助功能原型的开发，为无压力的烘焙体验铺平道路，让您可以告别复杂的数学、繁琐的电子表格以及规划时经常带来的焦虑。

story.x: Every sourdough baker knows the struggle of planning timelines by hand. You sit down with a notebook and a calculator, mapping out every step of your bake:
story.z: 每个酵母面包师都知道手工规划时间表的难度。你坐下来，拿着笔记本和计算器，规划出烘焙的每一步：

story.x: *   When do I feed my starter so it peaks on time?
story.z: * 我什么时候喂开胃菜才能按时达到峰值？

story.x: *   What time do I need to start mixing?
story.z: * 我需要什么时间开始混合？

story.x: *   If I want fresh bread for Sunday family dinner, when must I start the bulk fermentation?
story.z: * 如果我想要周日家庭晚餐的新鲜面包，我什么时候必须开始批量发酵？

story.x: And then, life happens.
story.z: 然后，生活发生了。

story.x: A meeting runs late, the kids need to be picked up, or an unexpected chore pops up. Suddenly, your meticulously designed timeline is ruined. Now, you're left with a choice: rewrite the whole timeline or don't make the sourdough.
story.z: 会议迟到，需要接孩子，或者出现意外的杂务。突然间，你精心设计的时间表被毁了。现在，你面临一个选择：重写整个时间线，或者不做酸面团。

story.x: Traditional meal-planning apps completely lack the specific, time-sensitive planning tools that bakers need. I believe calculation chaos shouldn't stand in the way of your baking success.
story.z: 传统的膳食计划应用程序完全缺乏面包师所需的具体的、时间敏感的计划工具。我相信计算混乱不应该妨碍您烘焙的成功。

story.x: I want to build a modern digital companion that removes the logistical friction of baking so you can focus on the craft. I want to turn sourdough baking from an overwhelming chore into a confident, joyful experience.
story.z: 我想建立一个现代的数字伴侣，消除烘焙的后勤摩擦，这样你就可以专注于工艺。我想把酵母烘焙从繁重的苦差事变成一种自信、快乐的体验。

story.x: Here is the simple, powerful workflow I want to develop:
story.z: 这是我想要开发的简单而强大的工作流程：

story.x: Tell the app exactly when, down to the minute, you want to pull your bread out of the oven.
story.z: 准确地告诉应用程序您想要将面包从烤箱中取出的时间，精确到分钟。

story.x: In seconds, Bake a Plan generates a complete, tailored schedule. It outlines when to feed your starter for peak ripeness, when to mix your dough, when to perform stretch-and-folds, and when to bake.
story.z: 只需几秒钟，“制定计划”就会生成完整的、量身定制的时间表。它概述了何时喂发酵剂以达到最佳成熟度、何时混合面团、何时进行拉伸和折叠以及何时烘烤。

story.x: Pull warm, golden sourdough out of the oven right on schedule—free from calculation stress, guesswork, and ruined timelines, ready to share with your family and friends.
story.z: 按时将温暖、金黄的酸面团从烤箱中取出——没有计算压力、猜测和时间线的破坏，准备好与家人和朋友分享。

story.x: I want Bake a Plan to be the ultimate companion for your entire kitchen adventure:
story.z: 我希望《烘焙计划》成为您整个厨房冒险的终极伴侣：

story.x: *   Your Recipe Vault: Easily add your own custom recipes—whether they are sourdough, yeasted sandwich breads, artisan pastries, quick breads, pies, or cookies.
story.z: * 您的食谱库：轻松添加您自己的自定义食谱 - 无论是酸面团、发酵三明治面包、手工糕点、速食面包、馅饼还是饼干。

story.x: *   Automated Shopping Lists: Once you schedule a bake, the app will be designed to compile your ingredients into an organized shopping list so you are never caught without a key ingredient.
story.z: * 自动购物清单：一旦您安排了烘焙，该应用程序将把您的原料编译成一个有组织的购物清单，这样您就永远不会缺少关键原料。

story.x: It’s easy to feel overwhelmed and unsupported when it feels like the whole world is set on convincing you that you lack the skills or time to be a home baker.
story.z: 当感觉整个世界都在说服你你缺乏成为家庭面包师的技能或时间时，你很容易感到不知所措和不受支持。

story.x: One of my biggest frustrations with modern baking is the way large food corporations try to convince us that baking is just too complicated, solely so they can sell us their ready-made, mass-produced products. But we all know that store-bought bread doesn't compare to a home-baked loaf.
story.z: 我对现代烘焙最大的挫败感之一是大型食品公司试图让我们相信烘焙太复杂了，只是为了向我们出售现成的、批量生产的产品。但我们都知道商店买的面包无法与家庭烘焙的面包相比。

story.x: By developing Bake a Plan, I want to help you take back control of your time, build self-sufficiency, and experience the pure pride of baking handmade bread for those you love.
story.z: 通过制定“烘焙计划”，我想帮助您重新掌控自己的时间，建立自给自足的能力，并体验为您所爱的人烘焙手工面包的纯粹自豪感。

story.x: Hi, I'm Jamiahus! Sourdough baking is my passion, but I'm also a User Experience (UX) Researcher with 13 years of experience uncovering friction in everyday activities and building digital experiences that people actually love.
story.z: 嗨，我是贾米亚胡斯！酸面团烘焙是我的热情所在，但我也是一名用户体验 (UX) 研究员，拥有 13 年发现日常活动中的摩擦和构建人们真正喜欢的数字体验的经验。

story.x: When I started sourdough baking during the pandemic, I experienced the exact same "calculation chaos" and scheduling stress that you do. I noticed that traditional meal-planning apps completely ignored the precision bakers needed, so I decided to use my professional research and design background to map out a solution.
story.z: 当我在大流行期间开始发酵酵母烘焙时，我经历了与你完全相同的“计算混乱”和日程安排压力。我注意到传统的膳食计划应用程序完全忽略了烘焙师所需的精准度，因此我决定利用我的专业研究和设计背景来制定解决方案。

story.x: I have the vision, the roadmap, and the passion to make Bake a Plan a reality. But to transition this project from a prototype design into a fully functional application, I need your help.
story.z: 我有愿景、路线图和热情，让制定计划成为现实。但为了将该项目从原型设计转变为功能齐全的应用程序，我需要您的帮助。

story.x: The primary goal of this campaign is to raise funds to move Bake a Plan from an initial concept into a fully working prototype. The majority of the budget will go directly into prototype engineering.
story.z: 该活动的主要目标是筹集资金，将“烘焙计划”从最初的概念转变为完全可行的原型。大部分预算将直接用于原型工程。

story.x: Unlike many lights designed for a single purpose, the WUBEN G6’s compact design opens up more ways to use it. Lightweight and easy to carry, it fits naturally into everyday life and on the go. Wherever life takes you, you can find a place for the G6.
story.z: 与许多专为单一用途设计的灯不同，WUBEN G6 的紧凑设计开辟了更多使用方式。它重量轻且易于携带，自然适合日常生活和旅途。无论生活带您去往何处，G6 都能为您找到一席之地。

story.x: The slim, portable WUBEN G6 offers adjustable brightness from 1 to 500 lumens and a beam distance of up to 66 m. From evening walks and home repairs to outdoor adventures and unexpected power outages, it’s ready to light up everyday moments.
story.z: 纤薄便携的 WUBEN G6 提供 1 至 500 流明的可调亮度，光束距离可达 66 m。从晚间散步和房屋维修到户外探险和意外停电，它随时可以照亮日常生活。

story.x: Beyond its main beam, the WUBEN G6 offers practical light right at the front. Two 1 W white LEDs deliver 100 lumens for close-up tasks, from checking your gear to making a quick repair. A compact red/blue indicator adds even more versatility: its 2-lumen red light can be used as a signal, and the indicator also shows the light’s power status.
story.z: 除了主光束之外，WUBEN G6 还在前方提供实用的光线。两个 1 W 白色 LED 可为近距离任务（从检查装备到快速维修）提供 100 流明的亮度。紧凑的红/蓝指示灯增加了更多的多功能性：其 2 流明红灯可用作信号，并且指示灯还显示灯的电源状态。

story.x: Slim, easy-to-carry design has been at the heart of the WUBEN G6 from the start. Thinner, then thinner still: at its narrowest point, the G6 is nearly as thin as a USB connector. The result is a thoughtful balance of everyday functionality and effortless portability.
story.z: 纤薄、易于携带的设计从一开始就是 WUBEN G6 的核心。越来越薄：在最窄处，G6 几乎与 USB 连接器一样薄。结果是日常功能和轻松便携性之间的深思熟虑的平衡。

story.x: The WUBEN G6’s concealed, three-way rotating clip quickly became a standout feature for its versatility. For the G6, we’ve taken that idea further with a thicker, sturdier clip and a wider opening, making it easier to attach to your gear and designed for a more secure hold. Clip it on, adjust the angle, and keep your light right where you need it.
story.z: WUBEN G6 的隐藏式三向旋转夹因其多功能性而迅速成为一个突出的特点。对于 G6，我们进一步采用了这一理念，采用了更厚、更坚固的夹子和更宽的开口，使其更容易连接到您的装备，并设计得更牢固。将其夹上，调整角度，然后将灯光保持在您需要的位置。

story.x: On the side opposite the G6’s rotating clip, a compact folding blade is integrated for everyday tasks and outdoor needs. It’s handy for opening packages, cutting cord, or taking care of quick campsite tasks.
story.z: 在 G6 旋转夹的对面，集成了一个紧凑的折叠刀片，可满足日常任务和户外需求。它可以方便地打开包裹、剪断电源线或处理快速的露营地任务。

story.x: The mini knife detaches from the G6, so you can choose how you carry it. Keep it attached for an all-in-one setup, or remove and stow it separately when you want to carry the G6 on its own. We’re also exploring additional accessory-mounting options to give you more ways to customize your setup.
story.z: 迷你刀与 G6 分离，因此您可以选择携带方式。将其固定以实现一体化设置，或者当您想单独携带 G6 时将其取下并单独存放。我们还在探索其他配件安装选项，为您提供更多自定义设置的方法。

story.x: We took a different approach with the G6’s switch. It responds to a light press with clear, direct tactile feedback, making operation simple and intuitive. Water won’t interrupt its response. Even underwater, the switch remains usable. A breakthrough in switch design that makes everyday operation easier.
story.z: 我们对 G6 的开关采取了不同的方法。轻轻一按，它就会产生清晰、直接的触觉反馈，使操作变得简单直观。水不会中断其反应。即使在水下，开关仍然可用。开关设计的突破，让日常操作更加轻松。

story.x: The G6’s high-density 400 mAh battery is protected against overcharging, over-discharge, overcurrent, and short circuits. Electrical insulation adds another layer of protection. The G6 also supports use while charging, so you can keep using the light while it’s plugged in.
story.z: G6 的高密度 400 mAh 电池具有防过度充电、过度放电、过流和短路保护。电气绝缘增加了另一层保护。 G6 还支持边充电边使用，因此您可以在插入电源时继续使用灯。

story.x: Made for everyday carry and long-term use, the WUBEN G6 clips onto clothing, backpacks, or key rings with a light press and detaches just as easily. Tested through more than 100,000 press cycles, the sturdy spring clip can support a 5 kg load, providing a secure, dependable hold day after day.
story.z: WUBEN G6 专为日常携带和长期使用而设计，只需轻轻一按即可夹在衣服、背包或钥匙圈上，也可以轻松拆卸。经过超过 100,000 次按压循环测试，坚固的弹簧夹可支撑 5 公斤负载，日复一日地提供安全、可靠的固定。

story.x: The Standard and Premium versions are identical in every way except for their materials. The Standard version is CNC-machined from 7075 aerospace-grade aluminum, while the Premium version is made from stonewashed titanium alloy.
story.z: 标准版和高级版除了材质不同外，在各方面都相同。标准版由 7075 航空级铝材 CNC 加工而成，而高级版则由石磨钛合金制成。

story.x: With a higher 120Hz refresh rate, colors cycle faster to help reduce visible rainbow effects. Combined with AURA 3 Series’s Anti-RBE technology, it delivers cleaner, more natural visuals across both 2D and 3D content.

story.x: 4K 120Hz Global MEMC intelligently smooths motion across the entire screen, reducing judder and motion blur while preserving image detail. From fast-paced sports to action-packed scenes, every movement stays smooth and clear.

story.x: Watch films exactly as intended—120Hz is an exact multiple of 24fps, displaying each cinematic frame five times in a consistent 5:5 cadence, without 3:2 pulldown judder.

story.x: Up to 8,000:1 native contrast for deeper black perception in large-screen projection — enabled by precision light control at the source.

story.x: Two irises work together to refine every beam of light.

story.x: Automatically adjusting the iris size based on scene brightness for optimal contrast and brightness.
story.z: 根据场景亮度自动调整光圈大小，以获得最佳对比度和亮度。

story.x: Our advanced DBLE technology boosts dynamic contrast by up to 10× while preserving shadow detail and true-to-life color.
story.z: 我们先进的 DBLE 技术可将动态对比度提高高达 10 倍，同时保留阴影细节和逼真的色彩。

story.x: RGB triple laser delivers a clear image in bright rooms for anytime viewing.
story.z: RGB 三重激光可在明亮的房间中提供清晰的图像，以便随时查看。

story.x: Natural dimensionality brings cinematic realism into your living space.
story.z: 自然维度将电影般的真实感带入您的生活空间。

story.x: Deeper blacks, brighter highlights, and richer colors across all major HDR formats.
story.z: 所有主要 HDR 格式都具有更深的黑色、更明亮的高光和更丰富的色彩。

story.x: RGB Triple Laser maintains accurate, vivid color quality — even at peak brightness.
story.z: RGB 三重激光即使在峰值亮度下也能保持准确、鲜艳的色彩质量。

story.x: Powered by XGIMI-developed X-VISION AI image processor, AURA 3 Series intelligently optimizes every frame in real time for sharper detail, richer contrast, and a more lifelike picture.
story.z: AURA 3系列搭载极米自主研发的X-VISION AI图像处理器，实时智能优化每一帧画面，细节更清晰、对比度更丰富、画面更逼真。

story.x: X-VISION intelligently reconstructs every frame in real time, restoring texture, refining edges, and bringing hidden details back into view.
story.z: X-VISION 实时智能重建每一帧，恢复纹理，细化边缘，并将隐藏的细节带回视野。

story.x: X-VISION analyzes every HDR scene in real time, dynamically optimizing brightness and contrast for brighter highlights, deeper shadows, and richer depth.
story.z: X-VISION 实时分析每个 HDR 场景，动态优化亮度和对比度，以获得更亮的高光、更深的阴影和更丰富的深度。

story.x: Enjoy instant access to Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, and more — no extra devices needed. Control your content effortlessly with Google Home and voice commands.
story.z: 享受即时访问 Netflix、YouTube、Prime Video 等内容 — 无需额外设备。使用 Google Home 和语音命令轻松控制您的内容。

story.x: 80W of room-filling sound with remarkable clarity and depth.
story.z: 80W 的声音充满整个房间，具有非凡的清晰度和深度。

story.x: Hear the movie, not the machine. AURA 3 Series keeps fan noise low, so you can stay immersed in movies, games, and music without distraction.
story.z: 听电影，而不是机器。 AURA 3 系列可保持较低的风扇噪音，让您可以专心沉浸在电影、游戏和音乐中。

story.x: Everything you need for a more responsive, immersive big-screen gaming experience.
story.z: 提供响应更快、身临其境的大屏幕游戏体验所需的一切。

story.x: Experience ultra-smooth 4K 120Hz gameplay with reduced motion blur, keeping fast action sharp and responsive.
story.z: 体验超流畅的 4K 120Hz 游戏体验，减少运动模糊，保持快速动作的锐利和响应。

story.x: VRR & AMD FreeSync™ deliver smooth, tear-free gaming with fluid frames and ultra-low latency.
story.z: VRR 和 AMD FreeSync™ 通过流畅的帧和超低延迟提供流畅、无撕裂的游戏体验。

story.x: Experience deeper contrast, lifelike colors, and enhanced shadow detail with Dolby Vision Gaming technology.
story.z: 通过杜比视界游戏技术体验更深的对比度、逼真的色彩和增强的阴影细节。

story.x: While other UST projectors lose image clarity at the edges, AURA 3 Series maintains full-frame sharpness and color consistency.
story.z: 虽然其他 UST 投影机在边缘失去图像清晰度，但 AURA 3 系列保持了全帧清晰度和色彩一致性。

story.x: Minimizes chromatic distortion — even at extreme projection angles.
story.z: 即使在极端的投影角度下，也能最大限度地减少色彩失真。

story.x: Maximizes light transmission while reducing reflection, providing higher brightness and improved image depth.
story.z: 最大限度地提高透光率，同时减少反射，提供更高的亮度并改善图像深度。

story.x: A precision-engineered optical stack ensures uniform sharpness across the entire screen.
story.z: 精密设计的光学堆栈可确保整个屏幕的清晰度一致。

story.x: Violoop can view and interact with two screens simultaneously, so you and Violoop can work on the same computer without getting in each other’s way.

story.x: Whether you shoot for clients or for yourself, the friction shows up in the same three places. Offloading. Checking. Editing. Here is what changes when all three move into the field with you.
story.z: 无论您是为客户还是为自己拍摄，摩擦都会出现在相同的三个地方。卸载。检查。编辑。当这三个人都和你一起进入这个领域时，就会发生以下变化。

story.x: From professional color grading and batch processing to focus stacking, HDR, and panorama stitching, PixelMob brings post-processing into your workflow with no additional subscription required.
story.z: 从专业的颜色分级和批处理到焦点堆叠、HDR 和全景拼接，PixelMob 将后期处理带入您的工作流程，无需额外订阅。

story.x: Once your work is ready, you can download apps like Instagram and share it instantly, making it faster and easier to get your finished work out there.
story.z: 一旦您的工作准备就绪，您就可以下载 Instagram 等应用程序并立即分享，从而更快、更轻松地完成您的工作。

story.x: PixelMob is a creative sub-brand of UnifyDrive, backed by years of expertise in NAS, hardware, and intelligent data management.
story.z: PixelMob 是 UnifyDrive 的创意子品牌，以 NAS、硬件和智能数据管理方面多年的专业知识为后盾。

story.x: Our previous product, UnifyDrive UT2, raised over $1 million on Kickstarter. Now, we're bringing that experience to PixelMob — built to help creators capture, manage, and create anywhere.
story.z: 我们之前的产品 UnifyDrive UT2 在 Kickstarter 上筹集了超过 100 万美元。现在，我们将这种体验引入 PixelMob，旨在帮助创作者随时随地捕捉、管理和创作。

story.x: Picture the shoot where nothing waits. Cards offload as you work. Clients approve from the set. The first grade happens before you pack the car. That means less hardware to invest in, fewer software subscriptions to carry, and hours returned to the work itself.
story.z: 想象一下没有什么等待的拍摄场景。当您工作时，卡片会被卸载。客户对此表示认可。第一年级发生在你装车之前。这意味着需要投资的硬件更少，需要携带的软件订阅更少，并且可以节省工作时间。

story.x: Traditional workflows make you stop shooting to offload. Every card transfer breaks your rhythm or waits until the shoot ends. PixelMob supports tethering via USB-C, Wi-Fi, or Ethernet, keeping your files backed up in the background without interrupting your workflow.
story.z: 传统的工作流程会让您停止拍摄以减轻负担。每次卡片传输都会打破您的节奏或等到拍摄结束。 PixelMob 支持通过 USB-C、Wi-Fi 或以太网进行网络共享，让您的文件在后台备份，而不会中断您的工作流程。

story.x: With preset color grades, every saved photo is automatically rendered with your intended look, ready for review right away.
story.z: 通过预设的颜色等级，每张保存的照片都会自动渲染成您想要的外观，可供立即查看。

story.x: Different cameras, different cards, different connections. PixelMob automatically recognizes CFexpress Type A, CFexpress Type B, SD UHS-II, and microSD cards, with USB-A and USB-C support for even more ways to bring your media together. Everything flows into a single backup workflow, ready to edit.
story.z: 不同的相机，不同的卡，不同的连接。 PixelMob 可自动识别 CFexpress Type A、CFexpress Type B、SD UHS-II 和 microSD 卡，并支持 USB-A 和 USB-C，以更多方式将您的媒体整合在一起。一切都流入一个备份工作流程中，随时可以编辑。

story.x: Importing from several cards matters only if the data moves fast. CFexpress backup runs up to 800 MB/s, backing up 1TB in as little as thirty minutes. Your files are ready for review, editing, or delivery while you are still on site.
story.z: 仅当数据快速移动时，从多张卡导入才有意义。 CFexpress 备份运行速度高达 800 MB/s，在短短 30 分钟内备份 1TB。当您仍在现场时，您的文件就可以进行审阅、编辑或交付。

story.x: See the difference in a real-world 27GB backup speed test: PixelMob finished in 3:50, compared with 5:55 on a MacBook Pro.
story.z: 查看真实 27GB 备份速度测试中的差异：PixelMob 以 3 分 50 秒完成，而 MacBook Pro 上为 5 分 55 秒。

story.x: You may already have data protection at the studio. Location work is where the gaps show. Accidental deletion, interrupted transfers, and storage failures all put footage at risk. PixelMob brings seven layers of protection into a portable workflow, wherever you shoot.
story.z: 您可能已经在工作室获得了数据保护。定位工作就是差距所在。意外删除、传输中断和存储故障都会使素材面临风险。无论您在何处拍摄，PixelMob 都能为便携式工作流程提供七层保护。

story.x: Beneath the interface, PixelMob is built with multiple layers of data protection engineered to safeguard your creative assets.
story.z: 在界面之下，PixelMob 构建了多层数据保护，旨在保护您的创意资产。

story.x: Long shoots drain everything. PixelMob carries up to 11,600mAh of built-in battery and accepts NP-F expansion, with intelligent power optimization and safety shielding for demanding outdoor production. It also reverse charges your cameras and devices.
story.z: 长芽会耗尽一切。 PixelMob 内置高达 11,600mAh 电池，并接受 NP-F 扩展，具有智能功耗优化和安全屏蔽功能，适合严苛的户外制作。它还可以为您的相机和设备反向充电。

story.x: *11,600mAh capacity and NP-F support on Pro. Standard features a 6,600mAh battery and does not support NP-F. NP-F batteries sold separately.
story.z: *Pro 上有 11,600mAh 容量和 NP-F 支持。标准配备 6,600mAh 电池，不支持 NP-F。 NP-F 电池单独出售。

story.x: Reviewing 8K RAW on set demands real memory. PixelMob runs 12GB of high-speed RAM for smooth on-device preview, playback, and processing, so decisions happen on location instead of at home.
story.z: 在片场查看 8K RAW 需要实内存。 PixelMob 运行 12GB 高速 RAM，可实现流畅的设备上预览、播放和处理，因此决策可以在现场而不是在家中进行。

story.x: *The listed 12GB RAM is for the Pro. The Standard features 6GB RAM.
story.z: *列出的 12GB RAM 适用于 Pro。标准配备 6GB RAM。

story.x: Reliable backup deserves real capacity. Dual M.2 2280 SSD slots and a mobile SSD expansion channel take PixelMob to 24TB, so large libraries stay protected and organized in one place.
story.z: 可靠的备份需要真正的容量。双 M.2 2280 SSD 插槽和移动 SSD 扩展通道将 PixelMob 提升至 24TB，因此大型库可以在一处得到保护和组织。

story.x: *The listed 3-bay design (up to 24TB) is for Pro. The Standard features a 2-bay design(up to 8TB), supporting M.2 2242/2230 SSDs.
story.z: *列出的 3 盘位设计（高达 24TB）适用于 Pro。标准版采用 2 盘位设计（最高 8TB），支持 M.2 2242/2230 SSD。

story.x: See, check, and record your shots right on set. PixelMob combines a bright, color-rich display with built-in recording capabilities, giving you a professional monitoring and recording solution wherever you shoot.
story.z: 在现场查看、检查并记录您的镜头。 PixelMob 将明亮、色彩丰富的显示屏与内置录制功能相结合，无论您在何处拍摄，都能为您提供专业的监控和录制解决方案。

story.x: Preview every shot without being behind the camera. PixelMob lets directors, clients, and teammates view footage in real time, whether they are beside you or miles away, so feedback happens while you are still shooting.
story.z: 无需在镜头后面即可预览每个镜头。 PixelMob 可让导演、客户和团队成员实时查看镜头，无论他们在您身边还是在数英里之外，因此当您仍在拍摄时就会收到反馈。

story.x: Complete your first review and cull right on location. From massive RAW photo libraries to high-resolution 8K footage, PixelMob delivers smooth, responsive browsing and culling that shifts more of post-production into the field.
story.z: 完成您的第一次审查并在现场进行挑选。从海量 RAW 照片库到高分辨率 8K 素材，PixelMob 提供流畅、响应灵敏的浏览和筛选，将更多的后期制作工作转移到现场。

story.x: Thousands of similar frames, one pass. LightBox automatically groups bursts, time-lapses, similar images, and subjects, while recognizing people, birds, animals, and other visual content. It also flags blurry, overexposed, underexposed, blank, and abnormal shots. Swipe to keep or cull with instant RAW previews.

story.x: 8K and Log footage slow down on-set review. FrameBox creates lightweight proxies with customizable settings while preserving timecode and audio. Add frame-accurate notes, voice memos, and markers to keep feedback organized.
story.z: 8K 和 Log 素材会减慢现场审查速度。 FrameBox 创建具有可自定义设置的轻量级代理，同时保留时间码和音频。添加帧精确注释、语音备忘录和标记，以保持反馈井井有条。

story.x: Unlike many lights designed for a single purpose, the WUBEN G6’s compact design opens up more ways to use it. Lightweight and easy to carry, it fits naturally into everyday life and on the go. Wherever life takes you, you can find a place for the G6.

story.x: The slim, portable WUBEN G6 offers adjustable brightness from 1 to 500 lumens and a beam distance of up to 66 m. From evening walks and home repairs to outdoor adventures and unexpected power outages, it’s ready to light up everyday moments.
story.z: 纤薄便携的 WUBEN G6 提供 1 至 500 流明的可调亮度，光束距离可达 66 m。从晚间散步和房屋维修到户外探险和意外停电，它随时可以照亮日常生活。

story.x: Beyond its main beam, the WUBEN G6 offers practical light right at the front. Two 1 W white LEDs deliver 100 lumens for close-up tasks, from checking your gear to making a quick repair. A compact red/blue indicator adds even more versatility: its 2-lumen red light can be used as a signal, and the indicator also shows the light’s power status.
story.z: 除了主光束之外，WUBEN G6 还在前方提供实用的光线。两个 1 W 白色 LED 可为近距离任务（从检查装备到快速维修）提供 100 流明的亮度。紧凑的红/蓝指示灯增加了更多的多功能性：其 2 流明红灯可用作信号，并且指示灯还显示灯的电源状态。

story.x: Slim, easy-to-carry design has been at the heart of the WUBEN G6 from the start. Thinner, then thinner still: at its narrowest point, the G6 is nearly as thin as a USB connector. The result is a thoughtful balance of everyday functionality and effortless portability.
story.z: 纤薄、易于携带的设计从一开始就是 WUBEN G6 的核心。越来越薄：在最窄处，G6 几乎与 USB 连接器一样薄。结果是日常功能和轻松便携性之间的深思熟虑的平衡。

story.x: The WUBEN G6’s concealed, three-way rotating clip quickly became a standout feature for its versatility. For the G6, we’ve taken that idea further with a thicker, sturdier clip and a wider opening, making it easier to attach to your gear and designed for a more secure hold. Clip it on, adjust the angle, and keep your light right where you need it.
story.z: WUBEN G6 的隐藏式三向旋转夹因其多功能性而迅速成为一个突出的功能。对于 G6，我们进一步采用了这一理念，采用了更厚、更坚固的夹子和更宽的开口，使其更容易连接到您的装备，并设计得更牢固。将其夹上，调整角度，然后将灯光保持在您需要的位置。

story.x: On the side opposite the G6’s rotating clip, a compact folding blade is integrated for everyday tasks and outdoor needs. It’s handy for opening packages, cutting cord, or taking care of quick campsite tasks.
story.z: 在 G6 旋转夹的对面，集成了一个紧凑的折叠刀片，可满足日常任务和户外需求。它可以方便地打开包裹、剪断电源线或处理快速的露营地任务。

story.x: The mini knife detaches from the G6, so you can choose how you carry it. Keep it attached for an all-in-one setup, or remove and stow it separately when you want to carry the G6 on its own. We’re also exploring additional accessory-mounting options to give you more ways to customize your setup.
story.z: 迷你刀与 G6 分离，因此您可以选择携带方式。将其固定以实现一体化设置，或者当您想单独携带 G6 时将其取下并单独存放。我们还在探索其他配件安装选项，为您提供更多自定义设置的方法。

story.x: We took a different approach with the G6’s switch. It responds to a light press with clear, direct tactile feedback, making operation simple and intuitive. Water won’t interrupt its response. Even underwater, the switch remains usable. A breakthrough in switch design that makes everyday operation easier.
story.z: 我们对 G6 的开关采取了不同的方法。轻轻一按，它就会产生清晰、直接的触觉反馈，使操作变得简单直观。水不会中断其反应。即使在水下，开关仍然可用。开关设计的突破，让日常操作更加轻松。

story.x: The G6’s high-density 400 mAh battery is protected against overcharging, over-discharge, overcurrent, and short circuits. Electrical insulation adds another layer of protection. The G6 also supports use while charging, so you can keep using the light while it’s plugged in.
story.z: G6 的高密度 400 mAh 电池具有防过度充电、过度放电、过流和短路保护。电气绝缘增加了另一层保护。 G6 还支持边充电边使用，因此您可以在插入电源时继续使用灯。

story.x: Made for everyday carry and long-term use, the WUBEN G6 clips onto clothing, backpacks, or key rings with a light press and detaches just as easily. Tested through more than 100,000 press cycles, the sturdy spring clip can support a 5 kg load, providing a secure, dependable hold day after day.
story.z: WUBEN G6 专为日常携带和长期使用而设计，只需轻轻一按即可夹在衣服、背包或钥匙圈上，也可以轻松拆卸。经过超过 100,000 次按压循环测试，坚固的弹簧夹可支撑 5 公斤负载，日复一日地提供安全、可靠的固定。

story.x: The Standard and Premium versions are identical in every way except for their materials. The Standard version is CNC-machined from 7075 aerospace-grade aluminum, while the Premium version is made from stonewashed titanium alloy.
story.z: 标准版和高级版除了材质不同外，在各方面都相同。标准版由 7075 航空级铝材 CNC 加工而成，而高级版则由石磨钛合金制成。

story.z: 凭借更高的 120Hz 刷新率，颜色循环更快，有助于减少可见的彩虹效应。与 AURA 3 系列的 Anti-RBE 技术相结合，它可以在 2D 和 3D 内容中提供更清晰、更自然的视觉效果。

story.x: 4K 120Hz Global MEMC intelligently smooths motion across the entire screen, reducing judder and motion blur while preserving image detail. From fast-paced sports to action-packed scenes, every movement stays smooth and clear.
story.z: 4K 120Hz Global MEMC 智能地平滑整个屏幕上的运动，减少抖动和运动模糊，同时保留图像细节。从快节奏的运动到充满动感的场景，每个动作都保持流畅清晰。

story.x: Watch films exactly as intended—120Hz is an exact multiple of 24fps, displaying each cinematic frame five times in a consistent 5:5 cadence, without 3:2 pulldown judder.
story.z: 完全按照预期观看电影 - 120Hz 是 24fps 的精确倍数，以一致的 5:5 节奏显示每个电影帧五次，没有 3:2 下拉抖动。

story.x: Up to 8,000:1 native contrast for deeper black perception in large-screen projection — enabled by precision light control at the source.
story.z: 高达 8,000:1 的原生对比度可在大屏幕投影中实现更深的黑色感知 — 通过光源处的精确光控制实现。

story.x: Two irises work together to refine every beam of light.
story.z: 两个虹膜共同作用，细化每一束光线。

story.x: Automatically adjusting the iris size based on scene brightness for optimal contrast and brightness.
story.z: 根据场景亮度自动调整光圈大小，以获得最佳对比度和亮度。

story.x: Our advanced DBLE technology boosts dynamic contrast by up to 10× while preserving shadow detail and true-to-life color.
story.z: 我们先进的 DBLE 技术可将动态对比度提高高达 10 倍，同时保留阴影细节和逼真的色彩。

story.x: RGB triple laser delivers a clear image in bright rooms for anytime viewing.
story.z: RGB 三重激光可在明亮的房间中提供清晰的图像，以便随时查看。

story.x: Natural dimensionality brings cinematic realism into your living space.
story.z: 自然维度将电影般的真实感带入您的生活空间。

story.x: Deeper blacks, brighter highlights, and richer colors across all major HDR formats.
story.z: 所有主要 HDR 格式都具有更深的黑色、更明亮的高光和更丰富的色彩。

story.x: RGB Triple Laser maintains accurate, vivid color quality — even at peak brightness.
story.z: RGB 三重激光即使在峰值亮度下也能保持准确、鲜艳的色彩质量。

story.x: Powered by XGIMI-developed X-VISION AI image processor, AURA 3 Series intelligently optimizes every frame in real time for sharper detail, richer contrast, and a more lifelike picture.
story.z: AURA 3系列搭载极米自主研发的X-VISION AI图像处理器，实时智能优化每一帧画面，细节更清晰、对比度更丰富、画面更逼真。

story.x: X-VISION intelligently reconstructs every frame in real time, restoring texture, refining edges, and bringing hidden details back into view.
story.z: X-VISION 实时智能重建每一帧，恢复纹理，细化边缘，并将隐藏的细节带回视野。

story.x: X-VISION analyzes every HDR scene in real time, dynamically optimizing brightness and contrast for brighter highlights, deeper shadows, and richer depth.
story.z: X-VISION 实时分析每个 HDR 场景，动态优化亮度和对比度，以获得更亮的高光、更深的阴影和更丰富的深度。

story.x: Enjoy instant access to Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, and more — no extra devices needed. Control your content effortlessly with Google Home and voice commands.
story.z: 享受即时访问 Netflix、YouTube、Prime Video 等内容 — 无需额外设备。使用 Google Home 和语音命令轻松控制您的内容。

story.x: 80W of room-filling sound with remarkable clarity and depth.
story.z: 80W 的声音充满整个房间，具有非凡的清晰度和深度。

story.x: Hear the movie, not the machine. AURA 3 Series keeps fan noise low, so you can stay immersed in movies, games, and music without distraction.
story.z: 听电影，而不是机器。 AURA 3 系列可保持较低的风扇噪音，让您可以专心沉浸在电影、游戏和音乐中。

story.x: Everything you need for a more responsive, immersive big-screen gaming experience.
story.z: 提供响应更快、身临其境的大屏幕游戏体验所需的一切。

story.x: Experience ultra-smooth 4K 120Hz gameplay with reduced motion blur, keeping fast action sharp and responsive.
story.z: 体验超流畅的 4K 120Hz 游戏体验，减少运动模糊，保持快速动作的锐利和响应。

story.x: VRR & AMD FreeSync™ deliver smooth, tear-free gaming with fluid frames and ultra-low latency.
story.z: VRR 和 AMD FreeSync™ 通过流畅的帧和超低延迟提供流畅、无撕裂的游戏体验。

story.x: Experience deeper contrast, lifelike colors, and enhanced shadow detail with Dolby Vision Gaming technology.
story.z: 通过杜比视界游戏技术体验更深的对比度、逼真的色彩和增强的阴影细节。

story.x: While other UST projectors lose image clarity at the edges, AURA 3 Series maintains full-frame sharpness and color consistency.
story.z: 虽然其他 UST 投影机在边缘失去图像清晰度，但 AURA 3 系列保持了全帧清晰度和色彩一致性。

story.x: Minimizes chromatic distortion — even at extreme projection angles.
story.z: 即使在极端的投影角度下，也能最大限度地减少色彩失真。

story.x: Maximizes light transmission while reducing reflection, providing higher brightness and improved image depth.
story.z: 最大限度地提高透光率，同时减少反射，提供更高的亮度并改善图像深度。

story.x: A precision-engineered optical stack ensures uniform sharpness across the entire screen.

story.x: Manual sourdough math is a stressful chore. Bake a Plan will automate your baking timeline so you never have to again.
story.z: 手工酵母数学是一项压力很大的苦差事。烘焙计划将使您的烘焙时间表自动化，这样您就不必再这样做了。

story.x: Sourdough baking is a beautiful craft but too often, the logistical planning of a bake feels like a stressful, mathematical chore. Between scheduling starter feeding intervals, anticipating peak ripeness, and manually working backward from your target oven time, it's easy to feel lost. Sourdough has a mind of its own, and managing it can feel like a full-time job.
story.z: 酸面团烘焙是一门美丽的手艺，但很多时候，烘焙的后勤规划感觉像是一项压力很大的数学苦差事。在安排发酵剂饲喂间隔、预测成熟度高峰以及从目标烤箱时间手动向后工作之间，很容易感到迷失。酸面团有自己的想法，管理它感觉就像是一份全职工作。

story.x: I want to build Bake a Plan to change that. With your support, I want to create a dynamic baking companion that automates your timeline and fits baking seamlessly into your active schedule. The primary purpose of this Kickstarter campaign is to fund the development of a functional prototype, paving the way for a stress-free baking experience where you can say goodbye to complicated math, tedious spreadsheets, and the anxiety that often comes with planning.
story.z: 我想制定一个烘焙计划来改变这一点。在您的支持下，我想创建一个动态烘焙伴侣，使您的时间线自动化，并将烘焙无缝地融入您的活动日程中。此次 Kickstarter 活动的主要目的是资助功能原型的开发，为无压力的烘焙体验铺平道路，让您可以告别复杂的数学、繁琐的电子表格以及规划时经常带来的焦虑。

story.x: Every sourdough baker knows the struggle of planning timelines by hand. You sit down with a notebook and a calculator, mapping out every step of your bake:
story.z: 每个酵母面包师都知道手工规划时间表的难度。你坐下来，拿着笔记本和计算器，规划出烘焙的每一步：

story.x: *   When do I feed my starter so it peaks on time?
story.z: * 我什么时候喂开胃菜才能按时达到峰值？

story.x: *   What time do I need to start mixing?
story.z: * 我需要什么时间开始混合？

story.x: *   If I want fresh bread for Sunday family dinner, when must I start the bulk fermentation?
story.z: * 如果我想要周日家庭晚餐的新鲜面包，我什么时候必须开始批量发酵？

story.x: And then, life happens.
story.z: 然后，生活发生了。

story.x: A meeting runs late, the kids need to be picked up, or an unexpected chore pops up. Suddenly, your meticulously designed timeline is ruined. Now, you're left with a choice: rewrite the whole timeline or don't make the sourdough.
story.z: 会议迟到，需要接孩子，或者出现意外的杂务。突然间，你精心设计的时间表被毁了。现在，你面临一个选择：重写整个时间线，或者不做酸面团。

story.x: Traditional meal-planning apps completely lack the specific, time-sensitive planning tools that bakers need. I believe calculation chaos shouldn't stand in the way of your baking success.
story.z: 传统的膳食计划应用程序完全缺乏面包师所需的具体的、时间敏感的计划工具。我相信计算混乱不应该妨碍您烘焙的成功。

story.x: I want to build a modern digital companion that removes the logistical friction of baking so you can focus on the craft. I want to turn sourdough baking from an overwhelming chore into a confident, joyful experience.
story.z: 我想建立一个现代的数字伴侣，消除烘焙的后勤摩擦，这样你就可以专注于工艺。我想把酵母烘焙从繁重的苦差事变成一种自信、快乐的体验。

story.x: Here is the simple, powerful workflow I want to develop:
story.z: 这是我想要开发的简单而强大的工作流程：

story.x: Tell the app exactly when, down to the minute, you want to pull your bread out of the oven.
story.z: 准确地告诉应用程序您想要将面包从烤箱中取出的时间，精确到分钟。

story.x: In seconds, Bake a Plan generates a complete, tailored schedule. It outlines when to feed your starter for peak ripeness, when to mix your dough, when to perform stretch-and-folds, and when to bake.
story.z: 只需几秒钟，“制定计划”就会生成完整的、量身定制的时间表。它概述了何时喂发酵剂以达到最佳成熟度、何时混合面团、何时进行拉伸和折叠以及何时烘烤。

story.x: Pull warm, golden sourdough out of the oven right on schedule—free from calculation stress, guesswork, and ruined timelines, ready to share with your family and friends.
story.z: 按时将温暖、金黄的酸面团从烤箱中取出——没有计算压力、猜测和时间线的破坏，准备好与家人和朋友分享。

story.x: I want Bake a Plan to be the ultimate companion for your entire kitchen adventure:
story.z: 我希望《烘焙计划》成为您整个厨房冒险的终极伴侣：

story.x: *   Your Recipe Vault: Easily add your own custom recipes—whether they are sourdough, yeasted sandwich breads, artisan pastries, quick breads, pies, or cookies.
story.z: * 您的食谱库：轻松添加您自己的自定义食谱 - 无论是酸面团、发酵三明治面包、手工糕点、速食面包、馅饼还是饼干。

story.x: *   Automated Shopping Lists: Once you schedule a bake, the app will be designed to compile your ingredients into an organized shopping list so you are never caught without a key ingredient.
story.z: * 自动购物清单：一旦您安排了烘焙，该应用程序将把您的原料编译成一个有组织的购物清单，这样您就永远不会缺少关键原料。

story.x: It’s easy to feel overwhelmed and unsupported when it feels like the whole world is set on convincing you that you lack the skills or time to be a home baker.
story.z: 当感觉整个世界都在说服你你缺乏成为家庭面包师的技能或时间时，你很容易感到不知所措和不受支持。

story.x: One of my biggest frustrations with modern baking is the way large food corporations try to convince us that baking is just too complicated, solely so they can sell us their ready-made, mass-produced products. But we all know that store-bought bread doesn't compare to a home-baked loaf.
story.z: 我对现代烘焙最大的挫败感之一是大型食品公司试图让我们相信烘焙太复杂了，只是为了向我们出售现成的、批量生产的产品。但我们都知道商店买的面包无法与家庭烘焙的面包相比。

story.x: By developing Bake a Plan, I want to help you take back control of your time, build self-sufficiency, and experience the pure pride of baking handmade bread for those you love.
story.z: 通过制定“烘焙计划”，我想帮助您重新掌控自己的时间，建立自给自足的能力，并体验为您所爱的人烘焙手工面包的纯粹自豪感。

story.x: Hi, I'm Jamiahus! Sourdough baking is my passion, but I'm also a User Experience (UX) Researcher with 13 years of experience uncovering friction in everyday activities and building digital experiences that people actually love.
story.z: 嗨，我是贾米亚胡斯！酸面团烘焙是我的热情所在，但我也是一名用户体验 (UX) 研究员，拥有 13 年发现日常活动中的摩擦和构建人们真正喜欢的数字体验的经验。

story.x: When I started sourdough baking during the pandemic, I experienced the exact same "calculation chaos" and scheduling stress that you do. I noticed that traditional meal-planning apps completely ignored the precision bakers needed, so I decided to use my professional research and design background to map out a solution.
story.z: 当我在大流行期间开始发酵酵母烘焙时，我经历了与你完全相同的“计算混乱”和日程安排压力。我注意到传统的膳食计划应用程序完全忽略了烘焙师所需的精准度，因此我决定利用我的专业研究和设计背景来制定解决方案。

story.x: I have the vision, the roadmap, and the passion to make Bake a Plan a reality. But to transition this project from a prototype design into a fully functional application, I need your help.
story.z: 我有愿景、路线图和热情，让制定计划成为现实。但为了将该项目从原型设计转变为功能齐全的应用程序，我需要您的帮助。

story.x: The primary goal of this campaign is to raise funds to move Bake a Plan from an initial concept into a fully working prototype. The majority of the budget will go directly into prototype engineering.

story.x: From leash pulling and recall to off-leash boundaries and barking, DogVibe gives you one consistent way to communicate with your dog, so everyday training leads to something bigger: more trust, more confidence, and more freedom together.

story.x: Unlike many lights designed for a single purpose, the WUBEN G6’s compact design opens up more ways to use it. Lightweight and easy to carry, it fits naturally into everyday life and on the go. Wherever life takes you, you can find a place for the G6.
story.z: 与许多专为单一用途设计的灯不同，WUBEN G6 的紧凑设计开辟了更多使用方式。它重量轻且易于携带，自然适合日常生活和旅途。无论生活带您去往何处，G6 都能为您找到一席之地。

story.x: The slim, portable WUBEN G6 offers adjustable brightness from 1 to 500 lumens and a beam distance of up to 66 m. From evening walks and home repairs to outdoor adventures and unexpected power outages, it’s ready to light up everyday moments.
story.z: 纤薄便携的 WUBEN G6 提供 1 至 500 流明的可调亮度，光束距离可达 66 m。从晚间散步和房屋维修到户外探险和意外停电，它随时可以照亮日常生活。

story.x: Beyond its main beam, the WUBEN G6 offers practical light right at the front. Two 1 W white LEDs deliver 100 lumens for close-up tasks, from checking your gear to making a quick repair. A compact red/blue indicator adds even more versatility: its 2-lumen red light can be used as a signal, and the indicator also shows the light’s power status.
story.z: 除了主光束之外，WUBEN G6 还在前方提供实用的光线。两个 1 W 白色 LED 可为近距离任务（从检查装备到快速维修）提供 100 流明的亮度。紧凑的红/蓝指示灯增加了更多的多功能性：其 2 流明红灯可用作信号，并且指示灯还显示灯的电源状态。

story.x: Slim, easy-to-carry design has been at the heart of the WUBEN G6 from the start. Thinner, then thinner still: at its narrowest point, the G6 is nearly as thin as a USB connector. The result is a thoughtful balance of everyday functionality and effortless portability.
story.z: 纤薄、易于携带的设计从一开始就是 WUBEN G6 的核心。越来越薄：在最窄处，G6 几乎与 USB 连接器一样薄。结果是日常功能和轻松便携性之间的深思熟虑的平衡。

story.x: The WUBEN G6’s concealed, three-way rotating clip quickly became a standout feature for its versatility. For the G6, we’ve taken that idea further with a thicker, sturdier clip and a wider opening, making it easier to attach to your gear and designed for a more secure hold. Clip it on, adjust the angle, and keep your light right where you need it.
story.z: WUBEN G6 的隐藏式三向旋转夹因其多功能性而迅速成为一个突出的功能。对于 G6，我们进一步采用了这一理念，采用了更厚、更坚固的夹子和更宽的开口，使其更容易连接到您的装备，并设计得更牢固。将其夹上，调整角度，然后将灯光保持在您需要的位置。

story.x: On the side opposite the G6’s rotating clip, a compact folding blade is integrated for everyday tasks and outdoor needs. It’s handy for opening packages, cutting cord, or taking care of quick campsite tasks.
story.z: 在 G6 旋转夹的对面，集成了一个紧凑的折叠刀片，可满足日常任务和户外需求。它可以方便地打开包裹、剪断电源线或处理快速的露营地任务。

story.x: The mini knife detaches from the G6, so you can choose how you carry it. Keep it attached for an all-in-one setup, or remove and stow it separately when you want to carry the G6 on its own. We’re also exploring additional accessory-mounting options to give you more ways to customize your setup.
story.z: 迷你刀与 G6 分离，因此您可以选择携带方式。将其固定以实现一体化设置，或者当您想单独携带 G6 时将其取下并单独存放。我们还在探索其他配件安装选项，为您提供更多自定义设置的方法。

story.x: We took a different approach with the G6’s switch. It responds to a light press with clear, direct tactile feedback, making operation simple and intuitive. Water won’t interrupt its response. Even underwater, the switch remains usable. A breakthrough in switch design that makes everyday operation easier.
story.z: 我们对 G6 的开关采取了不同的方法。轻轻一按，它就会产生清晰、直接的触觉反馈，使操作变得简单直观。水不会中断其反应。即使在水下，开关仍然可用。开关设计的突破，让日常操作更加轻松。

story.x: The G6’s high-density 400 mAh battery is protected against overcharging, over-discharge, overcurrent, and short circuits. Electrical insulation adds another layer of protection. The G6 also supports use while charging, so you can keep using the light while it’s plugged in.
story.z: G6 的高密度 400 mAh 电池具有防过度充电、过度放电、过流和短路保护。电气绝缘增加了另一层保护。 G6 还支持边充电边使用，因此您可以在插入电源时继续使用灯。

story.x: Made for everyday carry and long-term use, the WUBEN G6 clips onto clothing, backpacks, or key rings with a light press and detaches just as easily. Tested through more than 100,000 press cycles, the sturdy spring clip can support a 5 kg load, providing a secure, dependable hold day after day.
story.z: WUBEN G6 专为日常携带和长期使用而设计，只需轻轻一按即可夹在衣服、背包或钥匙圈上，也可以轻松拆卸。经过超过 100,000 次按压循环测试，坚固的弹簧夹可支撑 5 公斤负载，日复一日地提供安全、可靠的固定。

story.z: AURA 3 系列由双 TI DLPC 显示控制器提供支持，可提供 120Hz 的 4K UHD，使快速移动的场景保持清晰流畅，减少运动模糊并提供更清晰的移动细节。从体育和动作场景到游戏玩法，每一帧都保持清晰。

story.x: With a higher 120Hz refresh rate, colors cycle faster to help reduce visible rainbow effects. Combined with AURA 3 Series’s Anti-RBE technology, it delivers cleaner, more natural visuals across both 2D and 3D content.
story.z: 凭借更高的 120Hz 刷新率，颜色循环更快，有助于减少可见的彩虹效应。与 AURA 3 系列的 Anti-RBE 技术相结合，它可以在 2D 和 3D 内容中提供更清晰、更自然的视觉效果。

story.x: 4K 120Hz Global MEMC intelligently smooths motion across the entire screen, reducing judder and motion blur while preserving image detail. From fast-paced sports to action-packed scenes, every movement stays smooth and clear.
story.z: 4K 120Hz Global MEMC 智能地平滑整个屏幕上的运动，减少抖动和运动模糊，同时保留图像细节。从快节奏的运动到充满动感的场景，每个动作都保持流畅清晰。

story.x: Watch films exactly as intended—120Hz is an exact multiple of 24fps, displaying each cinematic frame five times in a consistent 5:5 cadence, without 3:2 pulldown judder.
story.z: 完全按照预期观看电影 - 120Hz 是 24fps 的精确倍数，以一致的 5:5 节奏显示每个电影帧五次，没有 3:2 下拉抖动。

story.x: Up to 8,000:1 native contrast for deeper black perception in large-screen projection — enabled by precision light control at the source.
story.z: 高达 8,000:1 的原生对比度可在大屏幕投影中实现更深的黑色感知 — 通过光源处的精确光控制实现。

story.x: Two irises work together to refine every beam of light.
story.z: 两个虹膜共同作用，细化每一束光线。

story.x: Automatically adjusting the iris size based on scene brightness for optimal contrast and brightness.
story.z: 根据场景亮度自动调整光圈大小，以获得最佳对比度和亮度。

story.x: Our advanced DBLE technology boosts dynamic contrast by up to 10× while preserving shadow detail and true-to-life color.
story.z: 我们先进的 DBLE 技术可将动态对比度提高高达 10 倍，同时保留阴影细节和逼真的色彩。

story.x: RGB triple laser delivers a clear image in bright rooms for anytime viewing.
story.z: RGB 三重激光可在明亮的房间中提供清晰的图像，以便随时查看。

story.x: Natural dimensionality brings cinematic realism into your living space.
story.z: 自然维度将电影般的真实感带入您的生活空间。

story.x: Deeper blacks, brighter highlights, and richer colors across all major HDR formats.
story.z: 所有主要 HDR 格式都具有更深的黑色、更明亮的高光和更丰富的色彩。

story.x: RGB Triple Laser maintains accurate, vivid color quality — even at peak brightness.
story.z: RGB 三重激光即使在峰值亮度下也能保持准确、鲜艳的色彩质量。

story.x: Powered by XGIMI-developed X-VISION AI image processor, AURA 3 Series intelligently optimizes every frame in real time for sharper detail, richer contrast, and a more lifelike picture.
story.z: AURA 3系列搭载极米自主研发的X-VISION AI图像处理器，实时智能优化每一帧画面，细节更清晰、对比度更丰富、画面更逼真。

story.x: X-VISION intelligently reconstructs every frame in real time, restoring texture, refining edges, and bringing hidden details back into view.
story.z: X-VISION 实时智能重建每一帧，恢复纹理，细化边缘，并将隐藏的细节带回视野。

story.x: X-VISION analyzes every HDR scene in real time, dynamically optimizing brightness and contrast for brighter highlights, deeper shadows, and richer depth.
story.z: X-VISION 实时分析每个 HDR 场景，动态优化亮度和对比度，以获得更亮的高光、更深的阴影和更丰富的深度。

story.x: Enjoy instant access to Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, and more — no extra devices needed. Control your content effortlessly with Google Home and voice commands.
story.z: 享受即时访问 Netflix、YouTube、Prime Video 等内容 — 无需额外设备。使用 Google Home 和语音命令轻松控制您的内容。

story.x: 80W of room-filling sound with remarkable clarity and depth.
story.z: 80W 的声音充满整个房间，具有非凡的清晰度和深度。

story.x: Hear the movie, not the machine. AURA 3 Series keeps fan noise low, so you can stay immersed in movies, games, and music without distraction.
story.z: 听电影，而不是机器。 AURA 3 系列可保持较低的风扇噪音，让您可以专心沉浸在电影、游戏和音乐中。

story.x: Everything you need for a more responsive, immersive big-screen gaming experience.
story.z: 提供响应更快、身临其境的大屏幕游戏体验所需的一切。

story.x: Experience ultra-smooth 4K 120Hz gameplay with reduced motion blur, keeping fast action sharp and responsive.
story.z: 体验超流畅的 4K 120Hz 游戏体验，减少运动模糊，保持快速动作的锐利和响应。

story.x: VRR & AMD FreeSync™ deliver smooth, tear-free gaming with fluid frames and ultra-low latency.
story.z: VRR 和 AMD FreeSync™ 通过流畅的帧和超低延迟提供流畅、无撕裂的游戏体验。

story.x: Experience deeper contrast, lifelike colors, and enhanced shadow detail with Dolby Vision Gaming technology.
story.z: 通过杜比视界游戏技术体验更深的对比度、逼真的色彩和增强的阴影细节。

story.x: While other UST projectors lose image clarity at the edges, AURA 3 Series maintains full-frame sharpness and color consistency.
story.z: 虽然其他 UST 投影机在边缘失去图像清晰度，但 AURA 3 系列保持了全帧清晰度和色彩一致性。

story.x: Minimizes chromatic distortion — even at extreme projection angles.
story.z: 即使在极端的投影角度下，也能最大限度地减少色彩失真。

story.x: Maximizes light transmission while reducing reflection, providing higher brightness and improved image depth.
story.z: 最大限度地提高透光率，同时减少反射，提供更高的亮度并改善图像深度。

story.x: A precision-engineered optical stack ensures uniform sharpness across the entire screen.
story.z: 精密设计的光学堆栈可确保整个屏幕的清晰度一致。

story.x: Manual sourdough math is a stressful chore. Bake a Plan will automate your baking timeline so you never have to again.
story.z: 手工酵母数学是一项压力很大的苦差事。烘焙计划将使您的烘焙时间表自动化，这样您就不必再这样做了。

story.x: Sourdough baking is a beautiful craft but too often, the logistical planning of a bake feels like a stressful, mathematical chore. Between scheduling starter feeding intervals, anticipating peak ripeness, and manually working backward from your target oven time, it's easy to feel lost. Sourdough has a mind of its own, and managing it can feel like a full-time job.
story.z: 酸面团烘焙是一门美丽的手艺，但很多时候，烘焙的后勤规划感觉像是一项压力很大的数学苦差事。在安排发酵剂饲喂间隔、预测成熟度高峰以及从目标烤箱时间手动向后工作之间，很容易感到迷失。酸面团有自己的想法，管理它感觉就像是一份全职工作。

story.x: I want to build Bake a Plan to change that. With your support, I want to create a dynamic baking companion that automates your timeline and fits baking seamlessly into your active schedule. The primary purpose of this Kickstarter campaign is to fund the development of a functional prototype, paving the way for a stress-free baking experience where you can say goodbye to complicated math, tedious spreadsheets, and the anxiety that often comes with planning.
story.z: 我想制定一个烘焙计划来改变这一点。在您的支持下，我想创建一个动态烘焙伴侣，使您的时间线自动化，并将烘焙无缝地融入您的活动日程中。此次 Kickstarter 活动的主要目的是资助功能原型的开发，为无压力的烘焙体验铺平道路，让您可以告别复杂的数学、繁琐的电子表格以及规划时经常带来的焦虑。

story.x: Every sourdough baker knows the struggle of planning timelines by hand. You sit down with a notebook and a calculator, mapping out every step of your bake:
story.z: 每个酵母面包师都知道手工规划时间表的难度。你坐下来，拿着笔记本和计算器，规划出烘焙的每一步：

story.x: *   When do I feed my starter so it peaks on time?
story.z: * 我什么时候喂开胃菜才能按时达到峰值？

story.x: *   What time do I need to start mixing?
story.z: * 我需要什么时间开始混合？

story.x: *   If I want fresh bread for Sunday family dinner, when must I start the bulk fermentation?
story.z: * 如果我想要周日家庭晚餐的新鲜面包，我什么时候必须开始批量发酵？

story.x: And then, life happens.
story.z: 然后，生活发生了。

story.x: A meeting runs late, the kids need to be picked up, or an unexpected chore pops up. Suddenly, your meticulously designed timeline is ruined. Now, you're left with a choice: rewrite the whole timeline or don't make the sourdough.
story.z: 会议迟到，需要接孩子，或者出现意外的杂务。突然间，你精心设计的时间表被毁了。现在，你面临一个选择：重写整个时间线，或者不做酸面团。

story.x: Traditional meal-planning apps completely lack the specific, time-sensitive planning tools that bakers need. I believe calculation chaos shouldn't stand in the way of your baking success.
story.z: 传统的膳食计划应用程序完全缺乏面包师所需的具体的、时间敏感的计划工具。我相信计算混乱不应该妨碍您烘焙的成功。

story.x: I want to build a modern digital companion that removes the logistical friction of baking so you can focus on the craft. I want to turn sourdough baking from an overwhelming chore into a confident, joyful experience.
story.z: 我想建立一个现代的数字伴侣，消除烘焙的后勤摩擦，这样你就可以专注于工艺。我想把酵母烘焙从繁重的苦差事变成一种自信、快乐的体验。

story.x: Here is the simple, powerful workflow I want to develop:
story.z: 这是我想要开发的简单而强大的工作流程：

story.x: Tell the app exactly when, down to the minute, you want to pull your bread out of the oven.
story.z: 准确地告诉应用程序您想要将面包从烤箱中取出的时间，精确到分钟。

story.x: In seconds, Bake a Plan generates a complete, tailored schedule. It outlines when to feed your starter for peak ripeness, when to mix your dough, when to perform stretch-and-folds, and when to bake.
story.z: 只需几秒钟，“制定计划”就会生成完整的、量身定制的时间表。它概述了何时喂发酵剂以达到最佳成熟度、何时混合面团、何时进行拉伸和折叠以及何时烘烤。

story.x: Pull warm, golden sourdough out of the oven right on schedule—free from calculation stress, guesswork, and ruined timelines, ready to share with your family and friends.
story.z: 按时将温暖、金黄的酸面团从烤箱中取出——没有计算压力、猜测和时间线的破坏，准备好与家人和朋友分享。

story.x: I want Bake a Plan to be the ultimate companion for your entire kitchen adventure:
story.z: 我希望《烘焙计划》成为您整个厨房冒险的终极伴侣：

story.x: *   Your Recipe Vault: Easily add your own custom recipes—whether they are sourdough, yeasted sandwich breads, artisan pastries, quick breads, pies, or cookies.
story.z: * 您的食谱库：轻松添加您自己的自定义食谱 - 无论是酸面团、发酵三明治面包、手工糕点、速食面包、馅饼还是饼干。

story.x: *   Automated Shopping Lists: Once you schedule a bake, the app will be designed to compile your ingredients into an organized shopping list so you are never caught without a key ingredient.
story.z: * 自动购物清单：一旦您安排了烘焙，该应用程序将把您的原料编译成一个有组织的购物清单，这样您就永远不会缺少关键原料。

story.x: It’s easy to feel overwhelmed and unsupported when it feels like the whole world is set on convincing you that you lack the skills or time to be a home baker.
story.z: 当感觉整个世界都在说服你你缺乏成为家庭面包师的技能或时间时，你很容易感到不知所措和不受支持。

story.x: One of my biggest frustrations with modern baking is the way large food corporations try to convince us that baking is just too complicated, solely so they can sell us their ready-made, mass-produced products. But we all know that store-bought bread doesn't compare to a home-baked loaf.
story.z: 我对现代烘焙最大的挫败感之一是大型食品公司试图让我们相信烘焙太复杂了，只是为了向我们出售现成的、批量生产的产品。但我们都知道商店买的面包无法与家庭烘焙的面包相比。

story.x: By developing Bake a Plan, I want to help you take back control of your time, build self-sufficiency, and experience the pure pride of baking handmade bread for those you love.
story.z: 通过制定“烘焙计划”，我想帮助您重新掌控自己的时间，建立自给自足的能力，并体验为您所爱的人烘焙手工面包的纯粹自豪感。

story.x: Hi, I'm Jamiahus! Sourdough baking is my passion, but I'm also a User Experience (UX) Researcher with 13 years of experience uncovering friction in everyday activities and building digital experiences that people actually love.
story.z: 嗨，我是贾米亚胡斯！酸面团烘焙是我的热情所在，但我也是一名用户体验 (UX) 研究员，拥有 13 年发现日常活动中的摩擦和构建人们真正喜欢的数字体验的经验。

story.x: When I started sourdough baking during the pandemic, I experienced the exact same "calculation chaos" and scheduling stress that you do. I noticed that traditional meal-planning apps completely ignored the precision bakers needed, so I decided to use my professional research and design background to map out a solution.
story.z: 当我在大流行期间开始发酵酵母烘焙时，我经历了与你完全相同的“计算混乱”和日程安排压力。我注意到传统的膳食计划应用程序完全忽略了烘焙师所需的精准度，因此我决定利用我的专业研究和设计背景来制定解决方案。

story.x: I have the vision, the roadmap, and the passion to make Bake a Plan a reality. But to transition this project from a prototype design into a fully functional application, I need your help.
story.z: 我有愿景、路线图和热情，让制定计划成为现实。但为了将该项目从原型设计转变为功能齐全的应用程序，我需要您的帮助。

story.x: The primary goal of this campaign is to raise funds to move Bake a Plan from an initial concept into a fully working prototype. The majority of the budget will go directly into prototype engineering.

story.x: From leash pulling and recall to off-leash boundaries and barking, DogVibe gives you one consistent way to communicate with your dog, so everyday training leads to something bigger: more trust, more confidence, and more freedom together.

story.x: Unlike many lights designed for a single purpose, the WUBEN G6’s compact design opens up more ways to use it. Lightweight and easy to carry, it fits naturally into everyday life and on the go. Wherever life takes you, you can find a place for the G6.
story.z: 与许多专为单一用途设计的灯不同，WUBEN G6 的紧凑设计开辟了更多使用方式。它重量轻且易于携带，自然适合日常生活和旅途。无论生活带您去往何处，G6 都能为您找到一席之地。

story.x: The slim, portable WUBEN G6 offers adjustable brightness from 1 to 500 lumens and a beam distance of up to 66 m. From evening walks and home repairs to outdoor adventures and unexpected power outages, it’s ready to light up everyday moments.
story.z: 纤薄便携的 WUBEN G6 提供 1 至 500 流明的可调亮度，光束距离可达 66 m。从晚间散步和房屋维修到户外探险和意外停电，它随时可以照亮日常生活。

story.x: Beyond its main beam, the WUBEN G6 offers practical light right at the front. Two 1 W white LEDs deliver 100 lumens for close-up tasks, from checking your gear to making a quick repair. A compact red/blue indicator adds even more versatility: its 2-lumen red light can be used as a signal, and the indicator also shows the light’s power status.
story.z: 除了主光束之外，WUBEN G6 还在前方提供实用的光线。两个 1 W 白色 LED 可为近距离任务（从检查装备到快速维修）提供 100 流明的亮度。紧凑的红/蓝指示灯增加了更多的多功能性：其 2 流明红灯可用作信号，并且指示灯还显示灯的电源状态。

story.x: Slim, easy-to-carry design has been at the heart of the WUBEN G6 from the start. Thinner, then thinner still: at its narrowest point, the G6 is nearly as thin as a USB connector. The result is a thoughtful balance of everyday functionality and effortless portability.
story.z: 纤薄、易于携带的设计从一开始就是 WUBEN G6 的核心。越来越薄：在最窄处，G6 几乎与 USB 连接器一样薄。结果是日常功能和轻松便携性之间的深思熟虑的平衡。

story.x: The WUBEN G6’s concealed, three-way rotating clip quickly became a standout feature for its versatility. For the G6, we’ve taken that idea further with a thicker, sturdier clip and a wider opening, making it easier to attach to your gear and designed for a more secure hold. Clip it on, adjust the angle, and keep your light right where you need it.
story.z: WUBEN G6 的隐藏式三向旋转夹因其多功能性而迅速成为一个突出的功能。对于 G6，我们进一步采用了这一理念，采用了更厚、更坚固的夹子和更宽的开口，使其更容易连接到您的装备，并设计得更牢固。将其夹上，调整角度，然后将灯光保持在您需要的位置。

story.x: On the side opposite the G6’s rotating clip, a compact folding blade is integrated for everyday tasks and outdoor needs. It’s handy for opening packages, cutting cord, or taking care of quick campsite tasks.
story.z: 在 G6 旋转夹的对面，集成了一个紧凑的折叠刀片，可满足日常任务和户外需求。它可以方便地打开包裹、剪断电源线或处理快速的露营地任务。

story.x: The mini knife detaches from the G6, so you can choose how you carry it. Keep it attached for an all-in-one setup, or remove and stow it separately when you want to carry the G6 on its own. We’re also exploring additional accessory-mounting options to give you more ways to customize your setup.
story.z: 迷你刀与 G6 分离，因此您可以选择携带方式。将其固定以实现一体化设置，或者当您想单独携带 G6 时将其取下并单独存放。我们还在探索其他配件安装选项，为您提供更多自定义设置的方法。

story.x: We took a different approach with the G6’s switch. It responds to a light press with clear, direct tactile feedback, making operation simple and intuitive. Water won’t interrupt its response. Even underwater, the switch remains usable. A breakthrough in switch design that makes everyday operation easier.
story.z: 我们对 G6 的开关采取了不同的方法。轻轻一按，它就会产生清晰、直接的触觉反馈，使操作变得简单直观。水不会中断其反应。即使在水下，开关仍然可用。开关设计的突破，让日常操作更加轻松。

story.x: The G6’s high-density 400 mAh battery is protected against overcharging, over-discharge, overcurrent, and short circuits. Electrical insulation adds another layer of protection. The G6 also supports use while charging, so you can keep using the light while it’s plugged in.
story.z: G6 的高密度 400 mAh 电池具有防过度充电、过度放电、过流和短路保护。电气绝缘增加了另一层保护。 G6 还支持边充电边使用，因此您可以在插入电源时继续使用灯。

story.x: Made for everyday carry and long-term use, the WUBEN G6 clips onto clothing, backpacks, or key rings with a light press and detaches just as easily. Tested through more than 100,000 press cycles, the sturdy spring clip can support a 5 kg load, providing a secure, dependable hold day after day.
story.z: WUBEN G6 专为日常携带和长期使用而设计，只需轻轻一按即可夹在衣服、背包或钥匙圈上，也可以轻松拆卸。经过超过 100,000 次按压循环测试，坚固的弹簧夹可支撑 5 公斤负载，日复一日地提供安全、可靠的固定。

story.z: 4K 120Hz Global MEMC 智能地平滑整个屏幕上的运动，减少抖动和运动模糊，同时保留图像细节。从快节奏的运动到充满动感的场景，每个动作都保持流畅清晰。

story.x: Watch films exactly as intended—120Hz is an exact multiple of 24fps, displaying each cinematic frame five times in a consistent 5:5 cadence, without 3:2 pulldown judder.
story.z: 完全按照预期观看电影 - 120Hz 是 24fps 的精确倍数，以一致的 5:5 节奏显示每个电影帧五次，没有 3:2 下拉抖动。

story.x: Up to 8,000:1 native contrast for deeper black perception in large-screen projection — enabled by precision light control at the source.
story.z: 高达 8,000:1 的原生对比度，可在大屏幕投影中实现更深的黑色感知 — 通过光源处的精确光控制实现。

story.x: Two irises work together to refine every beam of light.
story.z: 两个虹膜共同作用，细化每一束光线。

story.x: Automatically adjusting the iris size based on scene brightness for optimal contrast and brightness.
story.z: 根据场景亮度自动调整光圈大小，以获得最佳对比度和亮度。

story.x: Our advanced DBLE technology boosts dynamic contrast by up to 10× while preserving shadow detail and true-to-life color.
story.z: 我们先进的 DBLE 技术可将动态对比度提高高达 10 倍，同时保留阴影细节和逼真的色彩。

story.x: RGB triple laser delivers a clear image in bright rooms for anytime viewing.
story.z: RGB 三重激光可在明亮的房间中提供清晰的图像，以便随时观看。

story.x: Natural dimensionality brings cinematic realism into your living space.
story.z: 自然维度将电影般的真实感带入您的生活空间。

story.x: Deeper blacks, brighter highlights, and richer colors across all major HDR formats.
story.z: 所有主要 HDR 格式都具有更深的黑色、更明亮的高光和更丰富的色彩。

story.x: RGB Triple Laser maintains accurate, vivid color quality — even at peak brightness.
story.z: RGB 三重激光即使在峰值亮度下也能保持准确、鲜艳的色彩质量。

story.x: Powered by XGIMI-developed X-VISION AI image processor, AURA 3 Series intelligently optimizes every frame in real time for sharper detail, richer contrast, and a more lifelike picture.
story.z: AURA 3系列搭载极米自主研发的X-VISION AI图像处理器，实时智能优化每一帧画面，细节更清晰、对比度更丰富、画面更逼真。

story.x: X-VISION intelligently reconstructs every frame in real time, restoring texture, refining edges, and bringing hidden details back into view.
story.z: X-VISION 实时智能地重建每一帧，恢复纹理，细化边缘，并将隐藏的细节带回视野。

story.x: X-VISION analyzes every HDR scene in real time, dynamically optimizing brightness and contrast for brighter highlights, deeper shadows, and richer depth.
story.z: X-VISION 实时分析每个 HDR 场景，动态优化亮度和对比度，以获得更亮的高光、更深的阴影和更丰富的深度。

story.x: Enjoy instant access to Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, and more — no extra devices needed. Control your content effortlessly with Google Home and voice commands.
story.z: 享受即时访问 Netflix、YouTube、Prime Video 等内容 — 无需额外设备。使用 Google Home 和语音命令轻松控制您的内容。

story.x: 80W of room-filling sound with remarkable clarity and depth.
story.z: 80W 的声音充满整个房间，具有非凡的清晰度和深度。

story.x: Hear the movie, not the machine. AURA 3 Series keeps fan noise low, so you can stay immersed in movies, games, and music without distraction.
story.z: 听电影，而不是机器。 AURA 3 系列可保持较低的风扇噪音，让您可以专心沉浸在电影、游戏和音乐中。

story.x: Everything you need for a more responsive, immersive big-screen gaming experience.
story.z: 提供响应更快、身临其境的大屏幕游戏体验所需的一切。

story.x: Experience ultra-smooth 4K 120Hz gameplay with reduced motion blur, keeping fast action sharp and responsive.
story.z: 体验超流畅的 4K 120Hz 游戏体验，减少运动模糊，保持快速动作的锐利和响应。

story.x: VRR & AMD FreeSync™ deliver smooth, tear-free gaming with fluid frames and ultra-low latency.
story.z: VRR 和 AMD FreeSync™ 通过流畅的帧和超低延迟提供流畅、无撕裂的游戏体验。

story.x: Experience deeper contrast, lifelike colors, and enhanced shadow detail with Dolby Vision Gaming technology.
story.z: 通过杜比视界游戏技术体验更深的对比度、逼真的色彩和增强的阴影细节。

story.x: While other UST projectors lose image clarity at the edges, AURA 3 Series maintains full-frame sharpness and color consistency.
story.z: 虽然其他 UST 投影机在边缘失去图像清晰度，但 AURA 3 系列保持了全帧清晰度和色彩一致性。

story.x: Minimizes chromatic distortion — even at extreme projection angles.
story.z: 即使在极端的投影角度下，也能最大限度地减少色彩失真。

story.x: Maximizes light transmission while reducing reflection, providing higher brightness and improved image depth.
story.z: 最大限度地提高透光率，同时减少反射，提供更高的亮度并改善图像深度。

story.x: A precision-engineered optical stack ensures uniform sharpness across the entire screen.
story.z: 精密设计的光学堆栈可确保整个屏幕的清晰度一致。
