story.x: Designed for Curiosity
story.z: 专为好奇心而设计

story.x: Whether you are a student discovering science, a creator exploring textures, an engineer inspecting details, or simply someone curious about the world around you, iMicro XL15 makes microscopic exploration more accessible than ever.
story.z: 无论您是探索科学的学生、探索纹理的创造者、检查细节的工程师，还是只是对周围世界感到好奇的人，iMicro XL15 都能让微观探索变得比以往更容易。

story.x: The microscopic world is not far away. It is already around us. All we need is a better way to see it.
story.z: 微观世界并不遥远。它已经在我们身边了。我们所需要的只是一种更好的方式来看待它。

story.x: Here are some example micrographs taken with iMicro XL15 (on iPhone 14 Pro):
story.z: 以下是使用 iMicro XL15（在 iPhone 14 Pro 上）拍摄的一些显微照片示例：

story.x: Since 2018, we have been developing smartphone microscopes through our iMicro Fingertip Microscope series, including iMicro Q, iMicro C, iMicro Q2, iMicro Q2p, iMicro Q3, and iMicro Q3p.
story.z: 自 2018 年以来，我们一直通过 iMicro 指尖显微镜系列开发智能手机显微镜，包括 iMicro Q、iMicro C、iMicro Q2、iMicro Q2p、iMicro Q3 和 iMicro Q3p。

story.x: With the support of our Kickstarter community, we have received more than 40,000 pledges and delivered over 70,000 iMicros to users in 75 countries.
story.z: 在 Kickstarter 社区的支持下，我们已收到超过 40,000 份承诺，并向 75 个国家/地区的用户交付了超过 70,000 个 iMicro。

story.x: After years of development and continuous refinement, we created the next generation of the Fingertip Microscope — iMicro XL15.
story.z: 经过多年的开发和不断完善，我们创造了下一代指尖显微镜——iMicro XL15。

story.x: Unlike our high-magnification models, such as the iMicro Q3 and Q3p, the new iMicro XL15 is designed to make microscopic exploration easier, more enjoyable, and more creative.
story.z: 与 iMicro Q3 和 Q3p 等高放大倍率型号不同，新款 iMicro XL15 旨在让微观探索变得更轻松、更愉快、更具创意。

story.x: With its large field of view, long working distance, stable focusing system, and newly designed removable lighting module, XL15 offers a new and more flexible way to explore the tiny details all around you.
story.z: 凭借大视野、长工作距离、稳定的对焦系统以及全新设计的可拆卸照明模块，XL15 提供了一种新的、更灵活的方式来探索您周围的微小细节。

story.x: It’s more than just a microscope lens.
story.z: 它不仅仅是一个显微镜镜头。

story.x: It’s a complete micro exploration studio that fits in your pocket.
story.z: 这是一个完整的微型探索工作室，可以装在你的口袋里。

story.x: *   Extended 21 mm Working Distance
story.z: * 延长 21 毫米工作距离

story.x: *   Wide 10 mm Field of View
story.z: * 10 毫米宽视野

story.x: *   Newly designed dedicated Lighting Module
story.z: * 全新设计的专用照明模块

story.x: *   Stable, Precise Focusing with the Improved FS-5 Stand
story.z: * 使用改进的 FS-5 支架实现稳定、精确的对焦

story.x: *   Dedicated App and μRuler M included
story.z: * 包含专用应用程序和 μRuler M

story.x: *   Easy attach with Nano-Suction Lens Mount
story.z: * 使用纳米吸力镜头座轻松安装

story.x: *   Pocket-Ready Design, Complete Kit in one small Box
story.z: * 袖珍设计，完整套件装在一个小盒子里

story.x: Many microscopes have a very short working distance, making it difficult to observe three-dimensional objects or reach areas with limited access.
story.z: 许多显微镜的工作距离很短，因此很难观察三维物体或到达访问受限的区域。

story.x: The iMicro XL15 lens features an extended 21 mm working distance, providing more space between the lens and the subject. This allows you to capture details that are difficult or impossible to observe with conventional smartphone microscopes, while also making positioning, focusing, and lighting adjustments much easier.
story.z: iMicro XL15 镜头具有 21 毫米的扩展工作距离，在镜头和拍摄对象之间提供了更大的空间。这使您能够捕捉传统智能手机显微镜难以或无法观察的细节，同时也使定位、聚焦和照明调整变得更加容易。

story.x: The following image shows an earbud charging case and a microscopic view of the charging contacts hidden deep inside a narrow hole — a detail that becomes accessible thanks to the long working distance of iMicro XL15.
story.z: 下图显示了耳机充电盒和隐藏在窄孔深处的充电触点的显微视图 - 由于 iMicro XL15 的长工作距离，这一细节变得易于观察。

story.x: The iMicro XL15 features an impressive 10 mm field of view, allowing you to observe a much larger area while still capturing fine details.
story.z: iMicro XL15 具有令人印象深刻的 10 毫米视野，使您能够观察更大的区域，同时仍然捕捉精细细节。

story.x: Instead of only seeing a small section of an object, XL15 helps you understand the complete structure and overall context.
story.z: XL15 不是只看到对象的一小部分，而是帮助您了解完整的结构和整体背景。

story.x: As shown in the following image, the Apple Lightning charging connector can be viewed as a whole, while the fine details of the contacts remain clearly visible.
story.z: 如下图所示，Apple Lightning充电连接器可以作为整体查看，而触点的精细细节仍然清晰可见。

story.x: The iMicro XL15 is not only designed for a large field of view and long working distance — it also delivers impressive optical resolution.
story.z: iMicro XL15 不仅设计用于大视野和长工作距离，还提供令人印象深刻的光学分辨率。

story.x: With a wide-angle camera, XL15 can resolve details down to 8 μm, while the telephoto camera mode can achieve resolution as fine as 3 μm, revealing intricate structures that are invisible to the naked eye.
story.z: 使用广角摄像头时，XL15 可以解析低至 8 μm 的细节，而长焦摄像头模式可以实现精细至 3 μm 的分辨率，揭示肉眼不可见的复杂结构。

story.z: 您的个人设备上人工智能——具有长上下文记忆，可以了解您的工作方式。 Violoop 在设备上提供屏幕理解和个人记忆，完全在本地了解您的习惯、项目和偏好，无需云计算成本。

story.x: By combining OCR with a local model that understands long-form context, Violoop proactively moves your work forward—so you don’t have to write lengthy prompts for every task.
story.z: 通过将 OCR 与理解长格式上下文的本地模型相结合，Violoop 可以主动推动您的工作，因此您不必为每项任务编写冗长的提示。

story.x: Violoop reads and understands the text, pages, and interactive elements on your screen in real time. It controls your computer through mouse and keyboard inputs, carrying out tasks across apps without relying on app-specific APIs.
story.z: Violoop 实时读取并理解屏幕上的文本、页面和交互元素。它通过鼠标和键盘输入控制您的计算机，跨应用程序执行任务，而无需依赖应用程序特定的 API。

story.x: Violoop separates AI processing from independent security control through its dual-chip architecture. The processing chip runs the local model, while the security chip enforces physical authorization for sensitive actions.
story.z: Violoop 通过其双芯片架构将人工智能处理与独立的安全控制分开。处理芯片运行本地模型，而安全芯片则对敏感操作强制执行物理授权。

story.x: Violoop connects your computer and phone so work can continue beyond your desk. As long as your computer remains on and connected, Violoop can run tasks around the clock. From your phone, you can remotely view your computer’s screen, check task progress, and give new instructions.
story.z: Violoop 连接您的计算机和手机，以便您可以在办公桌外继续工作。只要您的计算机保持开启并连接，Violoop 就可以全天候运行任务。通过手机，您可以远程查看计算机屏幕、检查任务进度并给出新指示。

story.x: Violoop can view and interact with two screens simultaneously, so you and Violoop can work on the same computer without getting in each other’s way.

story.x: Violoop is for people who repeatedly extract information, copy and paste, fill out forms, organize files, and follow up on tasks. These activities have clear goals and repeatable steps, but are spread across different apps—taking time and interrupting focus.
story.z: Violoop 适合那些反复提取信息、复制和粘贴、填写表格、组织文件和跟踪任务的人员。这些活动有明确的目标和可重复的步骤，但分布在不同的应用程序中，既耗时又分散注意力。

story.x: Violoop handles the repetitive work across your apps, so you can focus on decisions, conversations, and creativity.
story.z: Violoop 可以处理您应用程序中的重复性工作，因此您可以专注于决策、对话和创造力。

story.x: Powered by dual TI DLPC display controllers, AURA 3 Series delivers 4K UHD at 120Hz, keeping fast-moving scenes sharp and fluid with reduced motion blur and clearer moving detail. From sports and action scenes to gameplay, every frame stays crisp.
story.z: AURA 3 系列由双 TI DLPC 显示控制器提供支持，可提供 120Hz 的 4K UHD，使快速移动的场景保持清晰流畅，减少运动模糊并提供更清晰的移动细节。从体育和动作场景到游戏玩法，每一帧都保持清晰。

story.x: With a higher 120Hz refresh rate, colors cycle faster to help reduce visible rainbow effects. Combined with AURA 3 Series’s Anti-RBE technology, it delivers cleaner, more natural visuals across both 2D and 3D content.
story.z: 凭借更高的 120Hz 刷新率，颜色循环更快，有助于减少可见的彩虹效应。与 AURA 3 系列的 Anti-RBE 技术相结合，它可以在 2D 和 3D 内容中提供更清晰、更自然的视觉效果。

story.x: 4K 120Hz Global MEMC intelligently smooths motion across the entire screen, reducing judder and motion blur while preserving image detail. From fast-paced sports to action-packed scenes, every movement stays smooth and clear.
story.z: 4K 120Hz Global MEMC 智能地平滑整个屏幕上的运动，减少抖动和运动模糊，同时保留图像细节。从快节奏的运动到充满动感的场景，每个动作都保持流畅清晰。

story.x: Watch films exactly as intended—120Hz is an exact multiple of 24fps, displaying each cinematic frame five times in a consistent 5:5 cadence, without 3:2 pulldown judder.
story.z: 完全按照预期观看电影 - 120Hz 是 24fps 的精确倍数，以一致的 5:5 节奏显示每个电影帧五次，没有 3:2 下拉抖动。

story.x: Up to 8,000:1 native contrast for deeper black perception in large-screen projection — enabled by precision light control at the source.
story.z: 高达 8,000:1 的原生对比度，可在大屏幕投影中实现更深的黑色感知 — 通过光源处的精确光控制实现。

story.x: Two irises work together to refine every beam of light.
story.z: 两个虹膜共同作用，细化每一束光线。

story.x: Automatically adjusting the iris size based on scene brightness for optimal contrast and brightness.
story.z: 根据场景亮度自动调整光圈大小，以获得最佳对比度和亮度。

story.x: Our advanced DBLE technology boosts dynamic contrast by up to 10× while preserving shadow detail and true-to-life color.
story.z: 我们先进的 DBLE 技术可将动态对比度提高高达 10 倍，同时保留阴影细节和逼真的色彩。

story.x: RGB triple laser delivers a clear image in bright rooms for anytime viewing.
story.z: RGB 三重激光可在明亮的房间中提供清晰的图像，以便随时观看。

story.x: Natural dimensionality brings cinematic realism into your living space.
story.z: 自然维度将电影般的真实感带入您的生活空间。

story.x: Deeper blacks, brighter highlights, and richer colors across all major HDR formats.
story.z: 所有主要 HDR 格式都具有更深的黑色、更明亮的高光和更丰富的色彩。

story.x: RGB Triple Laser maintains accurate, vivid color quality — even at peak brightness.
story.z: RGB 三重激光即使在峰值亮度下也能保持准确、鲜艳的色彩质量。

story.x: Powered by XGIMI-developed X-VISION AI image processor, AURA 3 Series intelligently optimizes every frame in real time for sharper detail, richer contrast, and a more lifelike picture.
story.z: AURA 3系列搭载极米自主研发的X-VISION AI图像处理器，实时智能优化每一帧画面，细节更清晰、对比度更丰富、画面更逼真。

story.x: X-VISION intelligently reconstructs every frame in real time, restoring texture, refining edges, and bringing hidden details back into view.
story.z: X-VISION 实时智能地重建每一帧，恢复纹理，细化边缘，并将隐藏的细节带回视野。

story.x: X-VISION analyzes every HDR scene in real time, dynamically optimizing brightness and contrast for brighter highlights, deeper shadows, and richer depth.
story.z: X-VISION 实时分析每个 HDR 场景，动态优化亮度和对比度，以获得更亮的高光、更深的阴影和更丰富的深度。

story.x: Enjoy instant access to Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, and more — no extra devices needed. Control your content effortlessly with Google Home and voice commands.
story.z: 享受即时访问 Netflix、YouTube、Prime Video 等内容 — 无需额外设备。使用 Google Home 和语音命令轻松控制您的内容。

story.x: 80W of room-filling sound with remarkable clarity and depth.
story.z: 80W 的声音充满整个房间，具有非凡的清晰度和深度。

story.x: Hear the movie, not the machine. AURA 3 Series keeps fan noise low, so you can stay immersed in movies, games, and music without distraction.

story.x: Everything you need for a more responsive, immersive big-screen gaming experience.
story.z: 提供响应更快、身临其境的大屏幕游戏体验所需的一切。

story.x: Experience ultra-smooth 4K 120Hz gameplay with reduced motion blur, keeping fast action sharp and responsive.
story.z: 体验超流畅的 4K 120Hz 游戏体验，减少运动模糊，保持快速动作的锐利和响应。

story.x: VRR & AMD FreeSync™ deliver smooth, tear-free gaming with fluid frames and ultra-low latency.
story.z: VRR 和 AMD FreeSync™ 通过流畅的帧和超低延迟提供流畅、无撕裂的游戏体验。

story.x: Experience deeper contrast, lifelike colors, and enhanced shadow detail with Dolby Vision Gaming technology.
story.z: 通过杜比视界游戏技术体验更深的对比度、逼真的色彩和增强的阴影细节。

story.x: While other UST projectors lose image clarity at the edges, AURA 3 Series maintains full-frame sharpness and color consistency.
story.z: 虽然其他 UST 投影机在边缘失去图像清晰度，但 AURA 3 系列保持了全帧清晰度和色彩一致性。

story.x: Minimizes chromatic distortion — even at extreme projection angles.
story.z: 即使在极端的投影角度下，也能最大限度地减少色彩失真。

story.x: Maximizes light transmission while reducing reflection, providing higher brightness and improved image depth.
story.z: 最大限度地提高透光率，同时减少反射，提供更高的亮度并改善图像深度。

story.x: A precision-engineered optical stack ensures uniform sharpness across the entire screen.
story.z: 精密设计的光学堆栈可确保整个屏幕的清晰度一致。
